title: Toxic wildfire haze spreads across South East Asia as 'super' El Niño intensifies
english: A powerful El Niño event is worsening drought conditions, leading to severe wildfires in Indonesia that have blanketed much of Southeast Asia in toxic smog. Millions of residents in countries like Malaysia, Singapore, and the Philippines are suffering from dangerous air quality levels, resulting in a surge of respiratory illnesses and other health complications. These recurring fires are largely attributed to long-standing environmental issues, including the clearing of forests and peatlands for industrial development.

oromo: Mudannoon qilleensaa 'El Nino' jedhamu cimaan hammaachuu isaan, qilleensi gogiinsaa uumamee fi ibidda bosonaa Indoneeshiyaa keessatti ka'een guutuu Kibba-Baha Eeshiyaa irratti aaraan summii ta'e akka babal'atu taasiseera. Biyyoottan akka Maleeshiyaa, Singaappoor fi Filippiins keessatti namoonni miliyoonaan lakkaa'aman qilleensa faalame sanaan miidhamaa jiraachuu isaanii fi dhibeewwan narvii fi hafuraa irra gahuun gabaafameera. title: More than 80 migrants feared dead after boat rescued off Canary Islands
english: A migrant boat that left The Gambia in early August was discovered adrift in the Atlantic Ocean after 27 days, with rescue teams finding 44 survivors and 5 bodies. Activists fear that over 80 people died during the dangerous journey to the Canary Islands. Due to hazardous weather and rough seas, rescuers were unable to recover the bodies from the vessel.
amharic: ከጋምቢያ ተነስቶ ወደ ካናሪ ደሴቶች ሲጓዝ የነበረ የስደተኞች ጀልባ በባህር ላይ ለ27 ቀናት ከቆየ በኋላ በስፓኒሽ የባህር ላይ አዳኞች ተገኝቷል። በጀልባው ላይ 44 ሰዎች በሕይወት ሲገኙ 5 አስከሬኖች ተገኝተዋል፣ ሆኖም ከ80 በላይ ሰዎች በአደጋው እንደሞቱ ተሰግቷል። አስቸጋሪ የአየር ሁኔታ እና ከፍተኛ ማዕበል በመኖሩ አዳኞች አስከሬኖቹን ከጀልባው ማውጣት አልቻሉም።
oromo: Dooniin godaantotaa Gamibiyaa irraa kaatee gara duubaatti imalaa turte guyyaa 27f galaana irratti erga haftee booda humnoonni fayyisaa namoota 44 lubbuun qaqqabaniiru. Haa ta'u malee, namoonni 80 ol ta'an imala kana irratti lubbuun darbuu isaanii sodaatama. Qilleensaa fi dambaliin galaanaa cimaa waan tureef, qaamoleen fayyisaa namoota du'anii argaman sanneen doonii irraa baasuu hin dandeenye.

title: UEFA opens disciplinary case against Fenerbahce’s Guendouzi and Greenwood
english: UEFA has launched a disciplinary investigation into Fenerbahce players Matteo Guendouzi and Mason Greenwood following their Champions League playoff match against Lyon. The players are accused of making offensive gestures toward opposing fans, which triggered a significant altercation between the teams. Fenerbahce plans to formally defend its players as the governing body reviews the chaotic events that occurred after the match.
amharic: የአውሮፓ እግር ኳስ ማህበር (UEFA) የሻምፒዮንስ ሊግ ማጣሪያ ጨዋታን ተከትሎ በፈነርባቼ ተጫዋቾች ማቴዮ ጉዌንዶዚ እና ሜሰን ግሪንዉድ ላይ የዲሲፕሊን ምርመራ ከፍቷል። ተጫዋቾቹ በሊዮን ደጋፊዎች ላይ ተገቢ ያልሆነ ምልክት በማሳየታቸው በሁለቱ ቡድኖች መካከል ግጭት ተቀስቅሶ ነበር። የቱርኩ ክለብ ፈነርባቼ የክለቡን እና የተጫዋቾቹን መብት ለማስከበር በሂደቱ ውስጥ አስፈላጊውን መከላከያ እንደሚያቀርብ አስታውቋል።
oromo: UEFA taphattoota Fenerbahce kan ta'an Matteo Guendouzi fi Mason Greenwood irratti qorannoo disiplinaa kan jalqabe tapha seensa Champions League Lyon wajjin taasisaniin booda. Taphattoonni kun deggertoota Lyon irratti gochaa jeequmsa uumuu danda'u raawwataniiru jedhamanii kan shakkaman yoo ta'u, kunis taphattoota gidduutti walitti bu'iinsa uumeera. Fenerbahce himannaa kana irraa taphattoota isaa ittisuuf qophiirra jiraachuu isaa ibseera.

title: Why has the Netherlands moved $10bn of its gold from the US?
english: The Dutch Central Bank has relocated $10 billion worth of its gold reserves from North America to the United Kingdom to improve financial security. This strategic move aims to diversify assets and boost the country's preparedness for potential global economic or geopolitical crises. By moving these holdings, the Netherlands intends to ensure its gold remains more accessible and resilient in an increasingly unstable international climate.
amharic: የኔዘርላንድስ ማዕከላዊ ባንክ የፋይናንስ ደህንነቱን ለማጠናከር 10 ቢሊዮን ዶላር የሚገመት የወርቅ ክምችቱን ከሰሜን አሜሪካ ወደ እንግሊዝ አስተላልፏል። ይህ እርምጃ የተወሰደው በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ እየጨመረ የመጣውን የፖለቲካ እና የኢኮኖሚ አለመረጋጋት ለመቋቋም የሚያስችል ዝግጅት ለማድረግ ነው። ሀገሪቱ በችግር ጊዜ የወርቅ ክምችቷን በአስተማማኝ ሁኔታ መጠቀም እንዲቻል የሀብት ክፍፍሏን በማስተካከል ላይ ትገኛለች።
oromo: Baankiin giddu galeessa biyya Netherlands, nageenya faayinaansii isaa cimsuuf jecha warqee doolaara biiliyoona 10 baasu kan ta'u, biyyoota Ameerikaa kaabaa irraa gara biyya Ingiliizitti jijjiireera. Tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame, rakkoolee diinagdee fi siyaasaa addunyaa irra jiran irratti of qopheessuufi. Netherlands, yeroo rakkoo keessatti warqeen ishee salphaatti akka argamuufi qabeenyi ishee akka eegamuuf jecha iddoo kuusaa warqee ishee kanas haala kanaan guurgeetti.

title: Feminist icon Gloria Steinem dies aged 92
english: Renowned feminist leader and writer Gloria Steinem has passed away in New York at the age of 92. A cofounder of Ms. Magazine, she spent decades traveling to advocate for women’s equality and bodily autonomy. Her legacy is defined by her dedication to social justice, her career as an influential journalist, and her unique ability to connect with others to drive change.
amharic: ታዋቂዋ የሴቶች መብት ተሟጋች እና ጸሐፊ ግሎሪያ ስታይነም በ92 ዓመታቸው በኒውዮርክ አርፈዋል። የኤም.ኤስ. መጽሔት መስራች የነበሩት ስታይነም ለሴቶች እኩልነት እና የሰውነት መብት ለበርካታ አስርት ዓመታት ሲታገሉ ቆይተዋል። እርሳቸው በማህበራዊ ፍትህ ላይ የነበራቸው ቁርጠኝነት፣ የጋዜጠኝነት ስራቸው እና ሰዎችን የማነቃቃት ችሎታቸው እንደ ታላቅ የህይወት ታሪካቸው ይወሳል።

Inniis guddiftuu fi hundessituu maagazina 'Ms.' ta'uudhaan, mirgaa fi walqixxummaa dubartootaaf waggoota hedduuf falmaa turan. Hojiin isaanii kan yaadatamuu fi mirga hawaasummaa irratti qaban, akkasumas gaazexeessummaa fi namoota kakaasuuf dandeettii qaban sanaan seenaa keessatti ni yaadatu.

title: Families perform symbolic funerals for missing Nepal flood victims
english: Families in Nepal are holding symbolic funeral rites for relatives who went missing following severe flooding one week ago. Because no bodies have been recovered, people are using grass effigies to represent their loved ones during these ceremonies. These rituals indicate that grieving families are losing hope that any survivors will be found.

oromo: Nepaalkatti balaa lolaa torban tokko dura mudateen namoota badeef maatiin isaanii sirna awwaalchaa fakkeenyaa gaggeessaa jiru. Reeffi namoota badee hin argamne waan ta'eef, maatiin warra miidhaman marga irraa fakkeenya namaa tolchuun sirna kana raawwachaa jiru. Gochi kun abdii namoota badee lubbuun argachuu laaffachaa dhufuu kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Kenya’s aviation strike is over, but the dispute is far from settled
english: A two-day aviation strike in Kenya recently ended after government officials and union leaders reached a temporary agreement, allowing airports to resume normal operations. However, the core issues regarding wages, union recognition, and collective bargaining remain unresolved despite previous attempts to settle them. The dispute continues to be a point of tension, as workers and authorities return to the negotiating table to address these long-standing grievances.
amharic: በኬንያ ለሁለት ቀናት ተካሂዶ የነበረው የአቪዬሽን ሠራተኞች የሥራ ማቆም አድማ፣ የመንግሥት ባለሥልጣናት እና የሠራተኛ ማህበር መሪዎች ጊዜያዊ ስምምነት ላይ በመድረሳቸው ተቋርጧል። ይሁን እንጂ የደመወዝ ጭማሪን፣ የማህበር ዕውቅናን እና የጋራ ድርድርን የሚመለከቱ ዋና ዋና ችግሮች እስካሁን መፍትሄ አላገኙም። ቀደም ሲል የተደረጉ ስምምነቶች ውጤታማ ባለመሆናቸው፣ አሁን የተፈጠረው አለመግባባት በድርድር ጠረጴዛ ላይ እንደሚቀጥል ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Hiriirri mormii hojjettoota xiyyaaraa Keeniyaa keessatti guyyoota lamaaf gaggeeffamaa ture, mootummaa fi hogganoonni gamtaa hojjettootaa walii galtee yerootii tokko irra erga ga'anii booda xumurameera. Haa ta'u malee, rakkooleen gurguddoon kan akka kafaltii mindaa, beekamtii gamtaa fi marii gamtaa waliinii ammayyuu furmaata hin arganne. Kanaan dura mariin godhamaa ture waan hin milkoofneef, wal dhibdeen kun ammayyuu itti fufuu fi mariin gara fuulduraatti itti fufuun isaa kan hin oolleedha.

title: Iran warns ‘dark months’ await US economy after renewed attacks
english: Iranian First Vice President Mohammad Reza Aref has threatened that the US economy faces difficult times ahead following recent military tensions between the two nations. This warning comes after President Donald Trump suggested the possibility of US military strikes against Iran and claimed control over the vital Strait of Hormuz. In response, Iran has pledged to launch a complex and asymmetrical retaliation against American interests.

oromo: Itti-aanaan Pirezidaantii Iraan Mohammad Reezaa Areef, walitti bu'iinsa biyyoota lamaan gidduutti uumameen dinagdeen Ameerikaa yeroo ulfaataa keessa akka seenu akeekkachiisaniiru. Akeekkachiisni kun kan dhufe erga Pirezidaantii Ameerikaa Doonaald Tiraamp Iraanirratti haleellaa raawwachuu akka danda'anii fi bishaan daangaa Hormuuz to'annoo isaanii jala akka jiru ibsanii booda. Iraanis tarkaanfii kanaan walqabatee haaloo ba'uuf qophii ta'uu ishee beeksisiteetti.

title: Israeli settlers 'hike' through my West Bank village. Next is the violent land grab
english: Residents of the West Bank village of Qira are raising alarms as armed Israeli settlers have begun conducting regular, unauthorized tours of their land. Villagers fear these hikes are a tactical scouting method used to claim historical ties to the area and pave the way for future territorial seizures. Similar activities in other areas have previously escalated into violent confrontations and the destruction of Palestinian homes.
amharic: በዌስት ባንክ በምትገኘው የቂራ መንደር ነዋሪዎች የታጠቁ እስራኤላዊያን ሰፋሪዎች ወደ መንደራቸው በየጊዜው መግባታቸውን በመቃወም ስጋታቸውን እየገለጹ ነው። መንደሩን የሚጎበኙት እነዚህ ቡድኖች ለወደፊቱ መሬቱን ለመቆጣጠር በማቀድ በታሪካዊ ስፍራዎች ላይ የይገባኛል ጥያቄ እያነሱ መሆኑን ነዋሪዎቹ ይናገራሉ። ተመሳሳይ ድርጊቶች በሌሎች አካባቢዎች ወደ ግጭትና የንብረት ውድመት ማምራታቸው ለነዋሪዎቹ ትልቅ ስጋት ሆኗል።
oromo: Namoonni magaalaa Qiraa jedhamtu kan West Bank keessatti argamtu, gareen qubattoota Israa'el meeshaa hidhatanii gara baadiyaa isaanii deddeebi'anii dhufuun isaanii yaaddoo guddaa uumeera. Jiraattonni akka jedhanitti, daawwannaan kun lafa isaanii fuudhuuf karoorfamee kan adeemsifamu yoo ta'u, iddoowwan seena qabeeyyii irratti mirga abbummaa himachuuf kan fayyaduudha. Akkaataa kanaan dura bakkeewwan biroo keessatti mul'ateen, sochiiwwan akkanaa gara walitti bu'iinsaatti fi manneen jireenyaa gubachuutti akka geessu sodaatameera.

title: Palestinian Islamic Jihad co-founder threatened with 'unlawful' deportation from Syria
english: Adel al-Natour, a 71-year-old co-founder of Palestinian Islamic Jihad, has been held in Syria without trial for nearly a year. His family recently received notice that he faces imminent deportation, despite authorities previously promising his release. Legal experts and family members are struggling to intervene because he is being detained arbitrarily without any formal charges.
amharic: የፍልስጤም እስላማዊ ጂሃድ መስራች የሆኑት የ71 ዓመቱ አዴል አል-ናቱር፣ ሶሪያ ውስጥ ያለ ክስ ለአንድ ዓመት ያህል ታስረዋል። ባለስልጣናት ቀደም ሲል ቢፈቱትም አሁን በድንገት ከሀገር ሊያባርሩት እንደሆነ ለቤተሰቡ አሳውቀዋል። በምንም አይነት መደበኛ ክስ ያልቀረበባቸው በመሆኑ፣ ቤተሰቦቻቸው እና የህግ ባለሙያዎች ይህንን የውጭ ሀገር የማባረር ውሳኔ ለመቃወም ተቸግረዋል።
oromo: Adel al-Natour, namni umrii 71 fi hundeessaa garee Palestinian Islamic Jihad ta'e, Suuriya keessatti waggaa tokkoof mana hidhaa kan ture yoo ta'u, hanga ammaatti himannaan tokkollee irratti hin banamne. Qaamoleen mootummaa duraan akka isa gadi dhiisan waadaa seenus, amma garuu biyyattiin ariitii dhaan isa baasuuf karoorfatte jirti. Maatiin isaa fi abbootiin seeraa himannaan seeraan ala ta'e kun akka dhaabatu gochuuf dhama'aa jiran.

title: Blair Institute denies former UK PM asked PA to remove 'Palestine' from school textbooks
english: The Tony Blair Institute has officially denied allegations that the former UK Prime Minister pressured the Palestinian Authority to delete the word 'Palestine' from educational materials. These claims originated from former diplomat Jeremy Greenstock, who suggested Blair was acting on behalf of a US-led peace committee. The institute firmly rejected these reports, labeling the accusations as entirely false and without any factual basis.
amharic: የቶኒ ብሌየር ተቋም የቀድሞው የእንግሊዝ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር የፍልስጤም አስተዳደር በትምህርት መጻሕፍት ውስጥ 'ፍልስጤም' የሚለውን ቃል እንዲያስወግድ መጠየቃቸውን የሚያሳይ ዘገባ በይፋ አስተባብለዋል። ይህ ክስ የተሰማው የቀድሞው ዲፕሎማት ጄረሚ ግሪንስቶክ ብሌየር በአሜሪካ የሚመራ የሰላም ኮሚቴን ወክለው ይህን ጥያቄ አቅርበዋል በማለታቸው ነው። ተቋሙ በበኩሉ እነዚህ ዘገባዎች ሙሉ በሙሉ ሀሰት እና ምንም አይነት መሰረት የሌላቸው መሆናቸውን በመግለጽ ውድቅ አድርጓቸዋል።
oromo: Dhaabbanni Tony Blair, gaaffii duraanii muummichi ministeeraa biyya Ingiliz aangoo Filisxeemii irraa barreeffama barnootaa keessatti jecha 'Filisxeem' jedhu akka balleessan dhiibbaa godhan jedhamee dhiyaate haale jira. Himannaan kun kan ka'e, diippiloomaatii duraanii Jeremy Greenstock, Blair koree nagaa Ameerikaan durfamu bakka bu'uudhaan gaaffii kana akka dhiyeessan dubbachuu isaanii hordofee dha. Dhaabbatichi gama isaatiin, oduun kun dhugaa kan hin qabneefi bu'uura kan hin qabne ta'uu ibsuun guutummaatti gadi dhisee jira.

title: Xi’s Egypt visit tests Cairo’s balancing act
english: Chinese President Xi Jinping recently visited Egypt to celebrate 70 years of diplomatic ties, resulting in new agreements on trade, artificial intelligence, and renewable energy. The visit featured the expansion of the Suez Canal economic zone, a strategic move for Egypt as it seeks to boost revenue following a major drop in canal traffic. By deepening these ties, Egypt aims to balance its international relations while integrating its national development goals with China's global infrastructure plans.
amharic: የቻይናው ፕሬዝዳንት ዢ ጂንፒንግ የሁለቱን ሀገራት የዲፕሎማሲ ግንኙነት 70ኛ ዓመት ምክንያት በማድረግ ግብፅን ጎብኝተዋል። በጉብኝታቸው ወቅት በንግድ፣ በሰው ሰራሽ አስተውሎት (AI) እና በታዳሽ ኃይል ዘርፎች በርካታ ስምምነቶች ተፈራርመዋል። ይህ ትብብር የሱዌዝ ካናል ኢኮኖሚ ቀጠናን በማስፋፋት የግብፅን የኢኮኖሚ ተግዳሮቶች ለመቅረፍ ያለመ ሲሆን፣ ግብፅ ከቻይና ጋር ያላትን ግንኙነት ከአገራዊ የልማት እቅዷ ጋር በማቀናጀት ላይ ትገኛለች።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Chaayinaa Sii Jinpiing waggaa 70ffaa hariiroo dippilomaasii biyyoota lamaanii kabajuuf gara Masrii imalaniiru. Imala kana keessatti waliigaltee daldalaa, teeknoolojii AI fi anniisaa haaromfamuu irratti mallatteessaniiru. Masriin diinagdee ishee cimsuufi qaxxaamura galaana Suweez irraa galii argamu dabaluuf jedhee, qaxxaamurichi Chaayinaa waliin walitti dhufeenya isaa cimseera; kunis karoora misooma Masrii fi Chaayinaa walitti fiduuf gargaara.

title: UN warns of 'supersized' El Niño as countries prepare for impact
english: The United Nations has issued a warning regarding an exceptionally powerful El Niño event that is expected to bring severe weather disruptions, including droughts and intense flooding, until early 2027. Climate experts highlight that this phenomenon, combined with human-caused global warming, could trigger record-breaking temperatures and significant environmental damage. Governments and international agencies are currently strengthening early warning systems and emergency preparations to protect vulnerable populations from these potential disasters.
amharic: የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት እስከ የካቲት 2027 ሊቆይ የሚችል እጅግ አደገኛ የሆነ የአየር ንብረት ክስተት ወይም ኤል ኒኞ (El Niño) በዓለማችን ላይ ሊከሰት እንደሚችል አስጠንቅቋል። ይህ ክስተት ከሰው ሰራሽ የአየር ንብረት ለውጥ ጋር ተዳምሮ በዓለም ዙሪያ ድርቅን እና ከፍተኛ ጎርፍን ጨምሮ ከባድ የአየር ሁኔታዎችን ሊያስከትል ይችላል። መንግስታት እና አለም አቀፍ ተቋማት በአየር ንብረት ለውጡ ሊጎዱ የሚችሉ ሰዎችን ለመታደግ አስቀድሞ የማስጠንቀቂያ ስርዓቶችን በማጠናከር ላይ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Dhaabbanni Mootummoota Gamtoomani, qilleensa 'El Niino' jedhamu kan haalaan cimaa ta'eefi hanga Guraandhala 2027 tureruu danda'u tokko akka mudatu akeekkachiiseera. Haalli kun jijjiirama qilleensa nam-tolchee waliin walitti dabalamuudhaan, addunyaa irratti hongee cimaafi rooba lolaa fiduun miidha guddaa dhaqqabsiisuu danda'a. Mootummoonniifi dhaabbileen idil-addunyaa miidhaa kana xiqqeessuuf, sirnoota akeekkachiisa duraa diriirsuufi qophiiwwan barbaachisoo ta'an godhachaa jiru.

title: Channel smuggling gangs resort to 'mega-dinghies' as crackdown limits small boat supply
english: People smuggling gangs in northern France are increasingly using larger boats, known as 'mega-dinghies,' because authorities have restricted the supply of standard small vessels. This shift in tactics comes as French and UK police intensify efforts to intercept crossings, forcing gangs to consolidate more passengers into single boats despite the increased danger. Consequently, the cost for migrants attempting these illegal journeys has risen significantly, reaching up to €2,000 per person.
amharic: በሰሜን ፈረንሳይ የሚንቀሳቀሱ የሰዎች አዘዋዋሪ ቡድኖች በመደበኛ ጀልባዎች አቅርቦት ላይ በተጣለው ቁጥጥር ምክንያት 'ሜጋ-ዲንጊስ' የሚባሉ ትላልቅ ጀልባዎችን መጠቀም ጀምረዋል። የፈረንሳይ እና የዩኬ ፖሊስ የሚያደርጉት ጥብቅ ክትትል አዘዋዋሪዎቹን ብዙ ሰዎችን በአንድ ትልቅ ጀልባ ላይ እንዲጭኑ ያስገደዳቸው ሲሆን፣ ይህም ለአደጋ የተጋለጠ ጉዞን እየፈጠረ ነው። በዚህም ምክንያት ህገ-ወጥ መንገድ ለሚጓዙ ስደተኞች የሚጠየቀው ክፍያ በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ ጨምሮ ወደ 2,000 ዩሮ ደርሷል።
oromo: Hojii seeraan alaa namoota ceesisuu irratti kan bobba'an gareewwan Faransaay kaabaa, to'annoo markaboobni xixiqqoo irratti godhameen kan ka'e markabooba gurguddaa 'mega-dinghies' jedhamanitti fayyadamuu jalqabaniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun kan dhufe poolisiin Faransaay fi UK daandii kanneen to'achuuf carraaqqii cimaa waan godhaniif, gareewwan kunneen imimmoo namoota hedduu markabooba tokko keessatti walitti qabanii akka fe'an isaan dirqisiiseera. Haala kanaan, baasiin godaantota karaa seeraan alaa kana fayyadamanii hanga Euro 2,000 ga'uun isaa gabaafameera.

title: Trump $1 coin makes him first living president on US currency in a century
english: The US Mint has released a new one-dollar coin featuring Donald Trump, marking the first time a living president has appeared on American currency in 100 years. This special-edition coin was created to commemorate the country's upcoming 250th anniversary. Although the coins sold out quickly online, they are made of copper alloys rather than real gold.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የገንዘብ ማተሚያ በዶናልድ ትራምፕ ምስል የተዘጋጀ አዲስ የአንድ ዶላር ሳንቲም አስተዋውቋል፤ ይህም ባለፉት 100 ዓመታት ውስጥ በሥልጣን ላይ ያለ ፕሬዚዳንት በገንዘብ ላይ ሲታይ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ ነው። ይህ ልዩ ሳንቲም የአገሪቱን 250ኛ ዓመት በዓል ምክንያት በማድረግ የተሠራ ነው። ሳንቲሞቹ በኢንተርኔት አማካኝነት በፍጥነት የተሸጡ ሲሆን፣ የተሠሩትም ከወርቅ ሳይሆን ከመዳብ ድብልቅ ነው።
oromo: Biroon maallaqa biyyattii (US Mint) saantima dolaara tokko kan fuula Donald Trump qabu baaseera; kunis waggaa 100 keessatti pirezidaantiin lubbuun jiran tokko maallaqa irratti yeroo mul'atan isa jalqabaati. Saantimni addaa kun ayyaana waggaa 250ffaa biyyattii yaadachuuf kan qophaaye dha. Saantimoonni kun marsariitii irratti hatattamaan kan dhumatan yoo ta'u, kanneenis warqee osoo hin taane sibiila biroo irraa kan hojjetaman dha.

title: NBA fines Clippers $30m, suspends several executives in Kawhi Leonard probe
english: The NBA has imposed a $30 million fine and stripped five first-round draft picks from the Los Angeles Clippers for violating salary cap rules involving Kawhi Leonard. Investigations revealed the team helped Leonard secure off-court income through prohibited endorsement deals and improperly paid his personal expenses. Additionally, owner Steve Ballmer was suspended for one year, and several other key executives faced suspensions for their roles in the misconduct.
amharic: የኤንቢኤ (NBA) የሎስ አንጀለስ ክሊፐርስ ቡድን በካዋይ ሌናርድ ዝውውር እና ክፍያ ዙሪያ የደመወዝ ጣሪያ ህጎችን በመጣሱ የ30 ሚሊዮን ዶላር ቅጣት እና የአምስት ዓመት የመጀመርያ ዙር የጨዋታ ምርጫዎችን ሰርዟል። የተደረገው ምርመራ ቡድኑ ለተጫዋቹ ህገ-ወጥ የገቢ ምንጮችን እና የንግድ ስምምነቶችን በማመቻቸት ለግል ወጪዎቹ ሽፋን እንደሰጠ አረጋግጧል። የቡድኑ ባለቤት ስቲቭ ባልመር ለአንድ ዓመት ከስራ ታግደዋል፣ ሌሎች የቡድኑ ከፍተኛ አመራሮችም በተመሳሳይ በተፈጠረው ጥሰት ምክንያት ቅጣት ተላልፎባቸዋል።
oromo: Liigii kubbaa basketbolii (NBA) garee Los Angeles Clippers irratti adabbii dolaara miiliyoona 30 fi kutaalee taphattoota filachuu shan kan waggoota dhufan jiraniin haqee jira. Adabbiin kun kan hordofame erga qorannoon gareen kun Kawhi Leonardif daldala dhokataa fi kafaltii seeraan alaa mijeessuu isaa fi baasii isaa hunda kan kaffale ta'uu mirkaneeffateen booda. Abbaan qabeenyaa garee kanaa Steve Ballmer waggaa tokkoof hojiirraa kan dhorkaman yoo ta'u, hoggantoonni olaanoon biroos badii kana keessatti hirmaachuu isaaniitiin adabbii irra ga'ee jira.

title: Russia to close Goethe-Institut centres as Germany tensions escalate
english: Russia is shutting down all Goethe-Institut cultural centers across the country following Germany's decision to close Russian institutions in Berlin and Bonn. This move comes as diplomatic tensions surge after a drone incident at a German airport, which European officials have labeled as a potential act of state-sponsored sabotage. While German authorities accuse Russia of organizing this hybrid attack, the Kremlin has denied involvement and labeled the German reaction as unreasonable.
amharic: ጀርመን በበርሊን እና በቦን የሚገኙ የሩሲያ ተቋማትን ለመዝጋት መወሰኗን ተከትሎ ሩሲያ በሀገሪቱ የሚገኙትን የጎተ-ኢንስቲትዩት ባህላዊ ማዕከላት እንደምትዘጋ አስታውቃለች። ይህ ውሳኔ የተላለፈው በጀርመን አየር ማረፊያ ላይ የተከሰተውን የድሮን ጥቃት ተከትሎ የሁለቱ ሀገራት ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ግንኙነት እየተባባሰ በመምጣቱ ነው። የአውሮፓ ህብረት እና የጀርመን ባለስልጣናት ይህንን ድርጊት የሩሲያ የሽብር ሙከራ ሲሉ ሲከሱ፣ የክሬምሊን አስተዳደር ግን ክሱ መሰረተ ቢስ ነው በማለት ውድቅ አድርጎታል።
oromo: Jarmanin buufataalee aadaa Raashiyaa kanneen Berlin fi Bonn keessatti argaman cufuuf murteessuu ishee hordofee, Raashiyaan dhaabbileen aadaa Goethe-Institut guutummaa biyyattii keessatti argaman akka cufaman labsiteetti. Tarkaanfiin kun kan dhufe erga buufata xiyyaaraa Jarman keessatti dhukaatin qilleensaa (drone) muudatee booda walitti bu’iinsi dippilomaasii lamaan gidduutti hammaatee jira. Aangootiifi qaamoleen Awurooppaa haleellaa kana sochii sabootaatiin raawwatame jechuun yoo himatan, mootummaan Raashiyaa garuu himannaa kana dhimmicha irratti dhiibbaa uumuuf dhiyaate jechuun haaleera.

title: OpenAI’s Sam Altman tells G20 AI will be as essential as electricity
english: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman recently advised G20 leaders to adopt artificial intelligence, comparing its future importance to that of electricity. He emphasized that AI will be a fundamental tool for the next generation, suggesting that ignoring its potential would be a significant historical mistake. Altman believes that integrating this technology is essential for progress in the modern era.
amharic: የOpenAI ዋና ስራ አስፈፃሚ ሳም አልትማን የጂ20 ሀገራት መሪዎች አርቲፊሻል ኢንተለጀንስን (AI) እንዲቀበሉ መክረዋል። የቴክኖሎጂውን አስፈላጊነት እንደ ኤሌክትሪክ መሰረታዊ እንደሆነ የገለፁት አልትማን፣ እሱን ችላ ማለት እንደ ኢንዱስትሪያል ዘመን የኤሌክትሪክ ሃይልን እንደመካድ ያለ ስህተት ነው ብለዋል። ይህ ቴክኖሎጂ ለወደፊት ትውልድ ወሳኝ መሳሪያ በመሆኑ፣ ሀገራት ሊጠቀሙበት እንደሚገባ አሳስበዋል።
oromo: Hogganaan dhaabbata OpenAI Saam Altmaan, gorsaa fi yaada isaa gaggeessitoota biyyoota G20f qooduun, teknoolojiin 'Artificial Intelligence' (AI) akka ibsaa fayyadamuu akka qaban dhaame. Altmaan akka jedhutti, AI gara fuulduraatti akka humna ibsaa barbaachisaa kan ta'uufi, kana fudhachuu diduun dogoggora seenaa keessa darbuu dha. Dhaloota haaraaf teknoolojichi meeshaa murteessaa waan ta'eef, biyyoonni fayyadamuu akka qaban gorseera.

title: Alcaraz, Sabalenka ease into US Open third round; American players shine
english: Tennis stars Carlos Alcaraz and Aryna Sabalenka successfully advanced to the third round of the US Open despite challenging conditions and some match delays. Several American players, including Jessica Pegula, Ben Shelton, and Frances Tiafoe, also secured victories to move further in the tournament. Alcaraz performed well despite early concerns about a wrist injury, while other top contenders like Daniil Medvedev also progressed to the next stage.
amharic: የቴኒስ ኮከቦች ካርሎስ አልካራዝ እና አሪና ሳባሌንካ በዩኤስ ኦፕን የቴኒስ ውድድር በተሳካ ሁኔታ ወደ ሶስተኛው ዙር ማለፋቸውን አረጋግጠዋል። እንደ ጄሲካ ፔጉላ፣ ቤን ሼልተን እና ፍራንሲስ ቲያፎ ያሉ አሜሪካዊ ተጫዋቾችም ድል በማድረግ ወደ ቀጣዩ ምዕራፍ ተሸጋግረዋል። አልካራዝ ቀደም ሲል በነበረበት የእጅ አንጓ ጉዳት ስጋት ውስጥ ቢሆንም አቋሙን በማሻሻል ወደ ቀጣዩ ዙር ማለፍ ችሏል።
oromo: Taphattoonni tenisii beekamoo Kaarloos Alkaaraaz fi Ariinaa Saabaleenkaas dorgommii US Open irratti gara sadarkaa sadaffaatti darbuu danda'aniiru. Akkasumas taphattoonni Ameerikaa kanneen akka Jeesiikaa Peeguulaa, Ben Sheeltan fi Firaansis Tiyaafoon injifannoo argachuun gara dorgommii itti aanuutti ce'aniiru. Alkaaraaz miidhaa harka isaa duraan qabu turu illee, dandeettii isaa agarsiisuun gara sadarkaa itti aanuutti darbeera.

title: Iran Red Crescent urges ICC probe into deadly US strike on wedding party
english: The Iranian Red Crescent has requested that the International Criminal Court investigate a recent US missile strike on a wedding in Kuhestak. The attack resulted in the deaths of four people, including two children, and left 67 others injured. The humanitarian organization argues that targeting a civilian gathering is a potential war crime, while the US military has denied allegations that it deliberately attacks civilians.
amharic: የኢራን ቀይ ጨረቃ ማህበር በኩሄስታክ በሰርግ ላይ የደረሰውን የአሜሪካ የሚሳኤል ጥቃት ዓለም አቀፉ የወንጀለኞች ፍርድ ቤት እንዲመረምር ጠይቋል። ጥቃቱ ሁለት ሕጻናትን ጨምሮ የአራት ሰዎችን ሕይወት የቀጠፈ ሲሆን ሌሎች 67 ሰዎች ደግሞ እንዲቆስሉ አድርጓል። የሰብአዊ መብት ድርጅቱ በሲቪሎች ላይ የተፈጸመውን ይህን ድርጊት የጦር ወንጀል ሊሆን እንደሚችል ሲገልጽ፣ የአሜሪካ ጦር ግን በሲቪሎች ላይ ያነጣጠረ ጥቃት እንደማይፈጽም በማስታወቅ ክሱን አስተባብሏል።
oromo: Hawaasni Ji'a Diimaa Iraan, miilaa duulaa Ameerikaan magaalaa Kuhestakitti cidha tokko irratti raawwatame irratti qorannoon akka gaggeeffamu Mana Murtii Yakka Addunyaaf gaaffii dhiyeesseera. Duulichi lubbuu namoota afurii kan galaafate yoo ta'u, ijoollee lama dabalatee namoonni 67 miidhamaniiru. Dhaabbatichi haleellaan kun yakka waraanaa ta'uu isaa ibsee, mootummaan Ameerikaa gama isaatiin siviliin irratti haleellaa akka hin raawwanne ifatti haaleera.

title: 'Inappropriate to say': Trump may still be considering CIA-led uprising in Iran
english: President Trump recently declined to clarify whether he would authorize the CIA to arm Iranian citizens for a potential uprising. This follows recent U.S. military strikes in Iran that resulted in multiple civilian casualties. While Trump expressed sympathy for protesters, his claims regarding the specific number of deaths in the country remain unverified.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ በኢራን አመጽ እንዲቀሰቀስ የሲአይኤ ታጣቂዎችን ስለመላክ የሚጠየቀውን ጥያቄ በግልጽ ለመመለስ ፈቃደኛ አልሆኑም። ይህ የሆነው አሜሪካ በኢራን የባህር ዳርቻ ላይ በፈጸመችው እና የበርካታ ንጹሃን ህይወት ባጠፋው ጥቃት ማግስት ነው። ትራምፕ ለኢራን ተቃዋሚዎች ያላቸውን አጋርነት ቢገልጹም፣ የተጠቀሱት የተጎጂዎች ቁጥር ግን በይፋ የተረጋገጠ አይደለም።
oromo: Pireezidaant Traamp mootummaan Ameerikaa finxaaleeyyii Iraan hidhachiisuun akka ka’an gochuuf CIA fayyadamuu danda’uu isaa irratti ibsa kennuuf fedhii hin qabne. Kunis kan ta’e yeroo Ameerikaan naannoo qarqara galaana Iraanitti haleellaa raawwatteen lubbuun namoota baay’ee darbee ture booda dha. Traamp gadda isaanii ibsuun kan dubbatan ta’us, lakkoofsi namoota du’anii jedhan garuu mirkanaa’aa miti.

title: UK must reject attempts to derail settlement trade ban
english: The UK government is considering a ban on trade with illegal Israeli settlements following international pressure and rising public dissatisfaction with past policies. Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband has proposed comprehensive measures in response to aggressive settlement expansion and ongoing violence in the West Bank. However, the government faces significant opposition from pro-Israel groups and the Israeli authorities, who are threatening retaliation to prevent these sanctions from taking effect.
amharic: የብሪታንያ መንግስት በአለም አቀፍ ጫና እና ካለፉት ፖሊሲዎች ጋር በተያያዘ በህዝብ ዘንድ ባለው ቅሬታ ምክንያት ከእስራኤል ህገ-ወጥ ሰፈሮች ጋር የሚደረገውን ንግድ ለመከልከል እያሰበ ነው። የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትሩ ኤድ ሚሊባንድ በዌስት ባንክ እየተካሄደ ያለውን ሰፈራ መስፋፋት እና ጥቃት ተከትሎ አጠቃላይ እርምጃዎችን ሀሳብ አቅርበዋል። ይሁን እንጂ መንግስት በእስራኤል ደጋፊ ቡድኖች እና በእስራኤል ባለስልጣናት በኩል ከፍተኛ ተቃውሞ እየገጠመው ሲሆን እነዚህ ማዕቀቦች ተግባራዊ እንዳይሆኑ የበቀል እርምጃ እንደሚወስዱ በማስፈራራት ላይ ናቸው።
oromo: Mootummaan UK dhiibbaa idil-addunyaa fi mormii ummataa darbee hordofee, daldala naannolee Israa'el seeraan alaa ta'an waliin godhamu dhorguuf karoorfataa jira. Ministirri Dhimma Alaa Ed Miliband babal'ina buufataalee fi hookkara naannoo West Bank ittisuuf tarkaanfiiwwan bal'aa fudhachuuf karoorfataniiru. Ta'us, mootummaan kun gareewwan Israa'el deggeran fi mootummaa Israa'el irraa mormii cimaa kan mudate yoo ta'u, isaanis tarkaanfiin kun akka hin milkoofneef miidhaa geessisuuf doorsisaa jiru.

title: UAE President and Trump hold phone call over Middle East developments
english: US President Donald Trump and UAE President Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan spoke over the phone to review current events in the Middle East. The two leaders focused on enhancing their collaborative relationship and discussed strategies to advance their shared interests. This conversation highlights the ongoing diplomatic engagement between the two nations.
amharic: የአሜሪካው ፕሬዚዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ እና የተባበሩት አረብ ኤምሬቶች ፕሬዚዳንት ሼክ መሐመድ ቢን ዛይድ አል ናህያን በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ወቅታዊ ሁኔታዎች ላይ በስልክ ተወያይተዋል። መሪዎቹ የሁለቱን ሀገራት የሁለትዮሽ ግንኙነት ይበልጥ ስለማጠናከር እና የጋራ ጥቅሞችን ስለማሳደግ አቅጣጫዎች መክረዋል። ውይይቱ በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ያለውን ቀጣይ ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ግንኙነት የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Pirezedantiin Ameerikaa Doonaald Tiraampii fi Pirezedantiin Emereetota Arabaa Gamtoomanii Sheek Mohaammad biin Zaayid Al Naahayaan haala yeroo biyyoota giddu-galeessa bahaa irratti bilbilaan mari'ataniiru. Hogganoonni kunneen hariiroo biyyoota lameenii caalaatti cimsuu fi faayidaa waliinii irratti xiyyeeffachuun mari'ataniiru. Mariin kun hariiroo diippiloomaasii biyyoota lameenii gidduu jiru kan ibsuudha.

title: Netanyahu says Israel working to overthrow Iran’s government
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu recently stated that his administration is actively pursuing the removal of the current Iranian government. During the same interview, he noted his satisfaction with military operations in Gaza and claimed that Israeli forces now hold territory across more than 60 percent of the strip. These comments highlight Israel's dual focus on aggressive foreign policy toward Iran and ongoing ground efforts in Palestinian territories.
amharic: የእስራኤል ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ የእስራኤል መንግስት የአሁኑን የኢራን አስተዳደር ከስልጣን ለማውረድ እየሰራ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። በዚሁ ቃለ መጠይቅ ላይ በጋዛ ስላለው ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴ ያላቸውን እርካታ የገለጹት ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትሩ፣ እስራኤል አሁን ከ60 በመቶ በላይ የሚሆነውን የጋዛ ግዛት እንደምትቆጣጠር ተናግረዋል። ይህ መግለጫ እስራኤል በኢራን ላይ ያላትን ጠንካራ አቋም እና በጋዛ የምታደርገውን ወታደራዊ ዘመቻ ያሳያል።
oromo: Mummichi Ministira Israa'el Benyaamin Neetaanyaahuu, mootummaan isaanii sirna mootummaa Iiraan amma jiru buusuuf hojjechaa akka jiru ibsan. Gaafii fi deebii kanaan, waraana Gaazaa keessatti gaggeeffamaa jiru irratti gammachuu qaban ibsuun, humnoonni Israa'el amma lafa Gaazaa keessaa dhibbeentaa 60 ol to'achuu isaanii dubbataniiru. Ibsi kun Israa'el gama kanaan siyaasa alaa Iiraan irratti qabduu fi duula waraanaa Gaazaa keessatti geggeessaa jirtu kan agarsiisu dha.

title: Morning update
english: Tensions between the US and Iran have escalated following heavy American airstrikes that resulted in 18 deaths and over 140 injuries, many of whom were women and children. Iran responded by placing additional naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz to challenge US claims of control over the waterway. Meanwhile, the UN is calling for an urgent return to diplomatic negotiations to reach a peaceful resolution, while US officials continue to coordinate with regional partners on potential future military actions.
amharic: በአሜሪካ እና በኢራን መካከል ያለው ውጥረት ከፍተኛ የአየር ጥቃቶችን ተከትሎ ተባብሷል፣ ይህም የ18 ሰዎችን ህይወት የቀጠፈ ሲሆን ከ140 በላይ የሚሆኑት ደግሞ ቆስለዋል። ኢራን የአሜሪካን የባህር መንገድ ቁጥጥር ለመቃወም በሆርሙዝ የባህር ዳርቻ ተጨማሪ ፈንጂዎችን እንደጣለች አስታውቃለች። የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት ሁለቱንም ወገኖች በዲፕሎማሲያዊ መንገድ ችግሮቻቸውን እንዲፈቱ ሲያሳስብ፣ የአሜሪካ ባለስልጣናት ግን ለቀጣይ ወታደራዊ እርምጃዎች ከክልሉ አጋሮቻቸው ጋር እየተመካከሩ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Harka lachuu gidduutti waraanni fi wal-dhibdeen erga weerara qilleensaarraa kanneen lubbuun darbee fi kanneen miidhaman lakkoofsi isaanii gahuun booda hammaachaa jira. Iraan to'annoo Ameerikaa kan karaa bishaan Hormuz irratti qabdu mormuuf, bishaanicha keessatti minaalee dabalataa kaa'uushee beeksisite. Gamtaan Mootummootaa biyyoota lamaan mariidhaan furmaata akka barbaadan gaafachaa jirullee, mootummaan Ameerikaa garuu tarkaanfii waraanaa gara fuulduraa irratti hiriyoota naannichaa wajjin mari'achaa jira.

title: Tens of thousands rally across Spain over Ceuta migrant crisis
english: Massive crowds gathered in various Spanish cities to demonstrate against the government's management of a recent migration crisis in Ceuta. Protesters expressed their frustration, claiming that authorities failed to handle the situation effectively. Additionally, many participants accused Morocco of playing a direct role in the sudden influx of migrants at the border.
amharic: በስፔን በተለያዩ ከተሞች በሴኡታ የተከሰተውን የስደተኞች ቀውስ በመቃወም በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎች ሰልፍ ወጥተዋል። ተቃዋሚዎቹ መንግስት ቀውሱን ለመቆጣጠር በቂ ስራ አልሰራም በማለት ቅሬታቸውን ገልጸዋል። ከዚህም በተጨማሪ ሰልፈኞቹ ሞሮኮ ድንበር ላይ ለታየው ድንገተኛ የስደተኞች መጉረፍ እጅ አለበት በማለት ወንጅለዋል።
oromo: Magaalota Ispeen garaa garaa keessatti namoonni kumaatamaan lakkaa'aman mootummaan rakkoo godaantotaa Ceuta irratti uumame hordofee tarkaanfii fudhate mormuun hiriira ba'aniiru. Hiriirtotni mootummaan rakkoo kana furuuf dandeettii dhabe jechuun komataniiru. Kana malees, hiriirtotni kunneen biyyi Morokkoo daangaa irratti yaa'iinsa godaantotaa tasa mudate keessatti harka qabdi jechuun himataniiru.

title: Maltese tycoon acquitted of killing journalist Daphne Caruana Galizia
english: A Maltese businessman named Yorgen Fenech has been found not guilty of orchestrating the 2017 car bomb assassination of investigative reporter Daphne Caruana Galizia. Fenech had maintained his innocence throughout the trial regarding his involvement in the attack. The journalist's death previously caused significant public unrest in Malta, eventually leading to the resignation of the country's Prime Minister.
amharic: ዮርገን ፌኔች የተባሉ የማልታ የንግድ ሰው በ2017 ዓ.ም የምርመራ ጋዜጠኛዋን ዳፍኒ ካሩአና ጋሊዚያን በመኪና ቦምብ ለመግደል አቅደዋል ተብለው የቀረበባቸው ክስ ውድቅ ተደረገ። ፌኔች በችሎቱ ላይ በጥቃቱ ውስጥ ምንም አይነት ተሳትፎ እንደሌላቸው በመግለጽ ክሱን አስተባብለዋል። የጋዜጠኛዋ ግድያ በማልታ ከፍተኛ ተቃውሞን ያስነሳ ሲሆን ይህም የሀገሪቱን ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ከስልጣን እንዲለቁ አስገድዷቸዋል።
oromo: Abbaan qabeenyaa biyya Maaltaa Yorgen Fenech jedhaman, bara 2017 gaazexeessituu qorattu Daphne Caruana Galizia boombii konkolaataan ajjeesuu irratti harka qabu jedhamanii himatamanis, mana murtii irraa bilisa ta'aniiru. Fenech yakka kana irratti hirmaannaa akka hin qabne ibsuun himannaa irratti dhiyaate haalaniiru. Duuti gaazexeessituu tanaatiis biyya Maaltaa keessatti mormii guddaa kaasee, dhumarratti muummicha ministeeraa biyyattii aangoo gadhiisuuf dirqisiiseera.

title: US forces board and destroy alleged cartel boat in eastern Pacific
english: The United States military intercepted and destroyed a vessel in the eastern Pacific Ocean that was being used as a mobile fueling station for drug smugglers. Officials suspect that the individuals on board belonged to the Los Choneros criminal organization based in Ecuador. The entire operation was documented by military cameras.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ወታደሮች በምስራቅ ፓስፊክ ውቅያኖስ ላይ ለዕፅ አዘዋዋሪዎች የነዳጅ ማደያ ሆኖ ያገለግል የነበረ ጀልባን ደርሰው አጥፍተዋል። በጀልባው ላይ የነበሩት ሰዎች ኢኳዶርን መሰረት ካደረገው 'ሎስ ቾኔሮስ' የተባለ የወንጀል ቡድን ጋር ግንኙነት እንዳላቸው ተጠራጥረዋል። የዚህ ዘመቻ ዝርዝር ሁኔታም በወታደራዊ ካሜራዎች ተቀርጾ ተይዟል።
oromo: Humnoonni waraana Ameerikaa galaana Paasifiik bahaatti doonii gurgurtoota sammuu namaa hadochanneessan (drug) boba'aadhaan gargaaruuf gargaaraa turte to'annoo jala oolchanii barbadeessaniiru. Namoonni doonii sanarra turan garee yakka 'Los Choneros' jedhamu kan Ekuwadoor keessatti argamu irraa dhufuu akka malu shakkameera. Hojiin kunis suuraa kaameran waraanaatiin qindaa'ee galmeeffameera.

title: Minneapolis shooting kills two, wounds three police officers
english: A shooting at a Minneapolis apartment complex resulted in the deaths of two victims and the suspected gunman. Three police officers were also injured during the response but remain in stable condition. Local authorities and state officials are currently investigating the incident to determine the motive behind the attack.
amharic: በሚኒያፖሊስ ከተማ በሚገኝ የመኖሪያ ሕንፃ ውስጥ በተፈጸመ ተኩስ ሁለት ሰዎች እና ተጠርጣሪው ታጣቂ ሕይወታቸው አልፏል። በስፍራው የደረሱ ሦስት የፖሊስ አባላትም ጉዳት ደርሶባቸው በህክምና ላይ ሲሆኑ ሁኔታቸውም የተረጋጋ ነው። ባለስልጣናት የጥቃቱን መንስኤ ለማወቅ ምርመራ እያደረጉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Magaala Minneapolisitti mana jireenyaa tokko keessatti dhukaasa banameen namoonni lama fi shakkamaan yakkaa du'aniiru. Poolisoonni sadii hojii eegumsaafi tasgabbii irratti erga bobba'anii booda miidhaan irra ga'ee, amma yaalamanii haalli isaanii gaariidha. Aangeyyonni mootummaa sababa yakka kanaa adda baasuuf qorannoo geggeessaa jiru.

title: Exclusive access as the search for Nepal’s tunnel workers intensifies
english: Rescue teams in Rasuwa, Nepal, are working tirelessly to reach hundreds of laborers trapped within hydropower tunnels following a disaster. Emergency crews are actively clearing heavy debris, mud, and rock to access the site. This mission remains critical as families wait for news of those who are currently missing.
amharic: በኔፓል ራስዋ አካባቢ በተከሰተው አደጋ በሃይድሮ ኤሌክትሪክ ዋሻዎች ውስጥ ተጠልፈው የሚገኙ በመቶዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሠራተኞችን ለማዳን የነፍስ አድን ቡድኖች ከፍተኛ ጥረት እያደረጉ ነው። አዳኞቹ በዋሻው ውስጥ የገቡ ሰዎችን ለማግኘት በጭቃ እና በድንጋይ የተደፈኑ መንገዶችን በከፍተኛ ጥንቃቄ በማጽዳት ላይ ናቸው። እስካሁን የጠፉ ሰዎችን ሁኔታ በመጠባበቅ ላይ ያሉ ቤተሰቦች ያሉት ሲሆን የነፍስ አድን ስራውም ተጠናክሮ ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Naannoo Rasuwaa kan Neppaalitti, hojjettoonni dhibbaan lakkaawwaman holqa hidha humna bishaanii keessatti erga qabamanii booda, gareen lubba baraartotaa isaan baasuuf carraaqqii cimaa gochaa jiru. Gareewwan kunneen namoota keessatti hafan arguuf biyyoo fi dhagaa iddoo sana cufame diiguun daandii banuuf dhama'aa jiru. Hojii baraarsa kanaa waliin walqabatee, maatiin namoota miidhaan irra ga'e haala jiran irraa odeeffannoo argachuuf dhiphachaa jiru.

title: UN chief urges US, Iran to 'return urgently to diplomacy' after renewed attacks
english: UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres has expressed serious concern over rising military tensions and recent violence between the United States and Iran. He strongly condemned the harm caused to civilians, specifically highlighting reports of casualties during a wedding ceremony. The UN leader is now calling on both nations to immediately stop the fighting and resolve their differences through peaceful diplomatic negotiations.
amharic: የተባበሩት መንግስታት ዋና ጸሐፊ አንቶኒዮ ጉቴሬዝ በአሜሪካ እና በኢራን መካከል እየተባባሰ በመጣው ወታደራዊ ግጭት የተሰማቸውን ጥልቅ ስጋት ገለጹ። በሲቪል ሰዎች ላይ የሚደርሰውን ጥቃት በተለይም በኢራን ሰርግ ላይ ተፈጽሟል የተባለውን የሞት አደጋ በጽኑ አውግዘዋል። ሁለቱም ሀገራት የጦርነት ድርጊታቸውን አቁመው ችግሮቻቸውን በሰላማዊ የዲፕሎማሲ ንግግር እንዲፈቱ ጥሪ አቅርበዋል።
oromo: Garee mirkaneessaa dhaabbata mootummoota gamtoomani Antonio Guterres waldhabdee waraanaa Ameerikaa fi Iraan gidduutti uumame ilaalchisee yaaddoo cimaa qaban ibsaniiru. Namoota nagaa irratti miidhaan gahuu isaa, keessattuu ayyaana cidha tokko irratti miidhaan gahuu isaa gabaafame kana jabeessee balaaleffateera. Hogganaan kunis biyyoonni lameen waraana dhaabanii marii diippiloomaasiin rakkoo isaanii akka furatan gaafateera.

title: Watch: Netanyahu nods along as yeshiva students chant anti-Palestinian song
english: A video shared online depicts Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu nodding his head while students at a religious school chant songs calling for vengeance against Palestinians. The group’s lyrics included slogans demanding the eradication of Palestinian identity. This footage has sparked public attention due to the Prime Minister’s visible reaction to the inflammatory chants.
amharic: በማህበራዊ ሚዲያ የተሰራጨ ቪዲዮ የእስራኤሉ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ በሃይማኖት ትምህርት ቤት ተማሪዎች ሲዘፈን የነበረውን የጥላቻ መዝሙር ጭንቅላታቸውን በመነቅነቅ ሲያዳምጡ ያሳያል። ተማሪዎቹ በፍልስጤማውያን ላይ በቀልን እና ጥፋትን የሚጠይቁ መፈክሮችን እያሰሙ ነበር። የጠቅላይ ሚኒስትሩ በዚህ አድሎአዊ መዝሙር ላይ ያሳዩት ምላሽ በብዙዎች ዘንድ ትኩረት ስቧል።
oromo: Viidiyoon miidiyaa hawaasaarratti maxxanfame tokko, muummicha ministeera Israa'el Benyamin Netanyaahu barattoota mana barnoota amantii biratti faaruu aarii fi jibba palastinaa irratti xiyyeeffatu yeroo dhaggeeffatan agarsiisa. Barattoonni kun faaruu isaanii keessatti palastinaawonni akka balleeffaman gaafataa turan. Gochi muummicha ministeerichaa faaruu kana mormuu mannaa itti gammaduun isaa kun mormii fi yaaddoo uumeera.

title: Yemeni army says 10 Houthi missiles launched against Taiz, Hodeidah
english: The Yemeni military reported that Houthi forces fired ten ballistic missiles at the Taiz and Hodeidah provinces on Wednesday. These attacks signify a recent escalation of violence within the ongoing regional conflict. Official sources confirmed the incident, though no casualties were immediately mentioned.
amharic: የየመን ጦር እንደገለጸው የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች ረቡዕ ዕለት በታኢዝ እና በሆዴይዳህ አውራጃዎች ላይ አስር የባላስቲክ ሚሳኤሎችን ተኩሰዋል። ይህ ድርጊት በአገሪቱ እየተካሄደ ባለው ግጭት ውስጥ የታየ አዲስ የጥቃት ማባባሻ ነው። ባለስልጣናት ጥቃቱን ያረጋገጡ ሲሆን ስለደረሰው ጉዳት እስካሁን የተገለጸ ነገር የለም።
oromo: Raayyaan ittisa biyya Yaman akka ibsetti, gareen Houthi guyyaa Arba’aa magaalonni Taiz fi Hodeidah gahuuf mijaatan xiyyaawwan boombii balistiki kudhan itti gadi dhiiseera. Gochi kun walitti bu’iinsa biyyattii keessatti adeemsifamaa jiru kan hammeessu ta’uu himameera. Qaamoleen mootummaa miidhaan qaqabe jiraachuusaa himuu baatanis, dhukaasicha mirkaneessaniiru.

title: Kuwaiti army says air defences intercepting attacks from Iran
english: The Kuwaiti military has reported that its air defense systems are actively engaging and intercepting missile and drone attacks launched from Iran. Authorities have formally requested that the public follow all provided safety and security guidelines during this period. The situation remains a serious matter of national defense for the country.
amharic: የኩዌት ጦር ከአይራን የተተኮሱ ሚሳይሎች እና ድሮኖችን በአየር መከላከያ ስርዓቱ አማካኝነት እየመከተ እንደሚገኝ አስታውቋል። የሀገሪቱ ባለስልጣናት ህዝቡ ደህንነቱን ለመጠበቅ ከሚመለከታቸው አካላት የሚሰጡትን መመሪያዎች በጥብቅ እንዲከተሉ ጥሪ አቅርበዋል። ይህ ክስተት በኩዌት ብሔራዊ ደህንነት ላይ የተጋረጠ አሳሳቢ ሁኔታ ተደርጎ ተወስዷል።
oromo: Raayyaan ittisa biyya Kuweyt, meeshalee waraanaa fi diroonii Iraan irraa dhufan qilleensa keessatti akka rukutanii kuffisaa jiran ibseera. Qaamoleen mootummaa ummanni yeroo rakkinaa kana keessatti qajeelfamoota nageenyaa hordofuun of eeggannoo akka godhan gaafataniiru. Haalli kun nageenya biyyattii irratti balaa kan uume ta'uu ibsameera.

title: Trump says hits on Iran 'help' Israel, Middle East and Europe
english: Former President Donald Trump stated that U.S. actions against Iran are intended to safeguard Israel, the Middle East, and Western nations. He argued that Iran poses an existential threat to these regions and, if left unchecked, would eventually target Europe and the United States. Therefore, he believes these aggressive measures are a necessary step to prevent wider global destruction.
amharic: ቀድሞ የነበሩት ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ፣ አሜሪካ በኢራን ላይ የምትወስዳቸው እርምጃዎች እስራኤልን፣ መካከለኛው ምስራቅን እና የምዕራባውያንን ዓለም ለመጠበቅ ያለሙ መሆናቸውን ተናግረዋል። ኢራን ለእነዚህ አካባቢዎች ስጋት እንደሆነች እና ካልተገታች በአውሮፓ እና በአሜሪካ ከተሞች ላይ ጥቃት ትሰነዝራለች ብለዋል። በመሆኑም እነዚህ እርምጃዎች ሰፊ ጥፋትን ለመከላከል አስፈላጊ እንደሆኑ ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Pirezedaantii duraanii Doonaald Traamp akka jedhanitti, tarkaanfiin Ameerikaan Iraan irratti fudhattu Israaʼel, Baha Giddu-galeessaa fi biyyoota dhihaa eeguuf kan gargaaru dha. Iraan naannolee kanaaf sodaa guddaa akka taatee fi yoo hin dhaabamne gara Awurooppaa fi magaalota Ameerikaatti ceeti jedhaniiru. Kanaafuu, tarkaanfiin kun balaa sadarkaa addunyaatti mudachuu danda'u ittisuuf murteessaa akka ta'e ibsaniiru.

title: Iran war live: Trump says renewed US-Iran clashes will not last ‘too long’
english: President Donald Trump has expressed confidence that the ongoing military conflict with Iran will be short-lived, though he warned that the United States remains prepared for further strikes. Meanwhile, Iranian officials report that recent American attacks have resulted in 19 deaths, including children, and have threatened that a new military strategy is being developed. Tensions between the two nations continue to escalate as both sides exchange warnings.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በኢራን ላይ እየተካሄደ ያለው ግጭት ለረጅም ጊዜ እንደማይቆይ ያላቸውን እምነት ገልጸዋል፤ ሆኖም አሜሪካ በማንኛውም ጊዜ ጥቃት ለመሰንዘር ዝግጁ መሆኗን አስታውቀዋል። በሌላ በኩል የኢራን ባለስልጣናት የአሜሪካ ጥቃት የ19 ሰዎችን ህይወት መቅጠፉን እና አዲስ የጦርነት ስልት እየቀረጹ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ያለው ውጥረት አሁንም በከፍተኛ ደረጃ ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Pirezidaant Doonaald Tiraamp walitti bu'iinsa Iraan waliin jiru kun yeroo gabaabaa keessatti kan xumuramu ta'uu amanuu ibsan, ta'us Ameerikaan yeroo kamiyyuu haleellaa raawwachuuf qophii ta'uu akeekkachiisaniiru. Gamasaaniin, mootummaan Iraan haleellaa Ameerikaan raawwatte kanaan lubbuun namoota 19 darbuusaa fi tarsiimoo waraanaa haaraa qopheeffachaa jiru ta'uu beeksisaniiru. Walitti bu'iinsi biyyoota lamaanii hammaachaa adeemaa jira.

title: Thousands protest in Spain as Ceuta’s migration crisis festers a month on
english: Massive protests have erupted across Spain following a major migration surge into the territory of Ceuta, where over 70,000 people crossed from Morocco in late July. Residents are demanding tougher action to address the influx, which has caused social instability and left thousands of migrants, including many children, living in desperate conditions. While the government is attempting to provide emergency support, the situation has ignited deep political tensions and community unrest in the region.
amharic: ከሞሮኮ ወደ ስፔን ግዛት ሴኡታ ከ70,000 በላይ ስደተኞች በሐምሌ ወር መገባደጃ ላይ መግባታቸውን ተከትሎ በመላው ስፔን ከፍተኛ ተቃውሞዎች ተቀስቅሰዋል። ነዋሪዎቹ ስደተኞች በመግባታቸው ምክንያት የተፈጠረውን ማህበራዊ አለመረጋጋት ለመቅረፍ መንግስት ጥብቅ እርምጃ እንዲወስድ እየጠየቁ ነው። መንግስት አስቸኳይ ድጋፍ ለማድረግ ቢሞክርም፣ በክልሉ ያለው የሰብአዊ ሁኔታ አስቸጋሪ ሆኖ መቀጠሉ ከፍተኛ የፖለቲካ ውጥረት እና ግጭቶችን አስከትሏል።
oromo: Ji'a Adoolessaa keessa godaantota kuma 70 ol ta'an gara lafa Sipeen kan taate Sewutaatti seenuun isaa biyyattii keessatti mormii guddaa kaaseera. Jiraattoonni mormii kana gaggeessaa jiran godaantota gara lafa isaanii seenaniif tarkaanfii cimaa akka fudhatamuufi tasgabbii akka deebi'u gaafachaa jiru. Mootummaan gargaarsa ariifachiisaa kennuuf yaalii gochaa jirus, haalli jiru hammaataa deemee fi waldhabdee siyaasaa guddaa uumeera.

title: Did DOGE ruin America’s food safety system?
english: The United States is currently facing its biggest outbreak of Cyclospora, which has caused over 11,000 people to become sick. Experts are investigating whether recent funding cuts made under the Trump administration to public health agencies like the FDA and CDC have weakened the country's food safety oversight. Concerns are mounting that these budgetary reductions may have undermined the government's ability to protect the food supply effectively.
amharic: አሜሪካ በአሁኑ ሰዓት ከ11,000 በላይ ሰዎችን በበሽታ ያጠቃውን ታይቶ የማይታወቅ የሳይክሎስፖራ ወረርሽኝ እየተጋፈጠች ትገኛለች። የጤና ባለሙያዎች በዶናልድ ትራምፕ አስተዳደር ወቅት በኤፍዲኤ (FDA) እና በሲዲሲ (CDC) ላይ የተደረጉ የበጀት ቅነሳዎች የምግብ ደህንነት ቁጥጥር ሥርዓቱን እንዳዳከሙት እየመረመሩ ነው። ይህ የበጀት ቅነሳ የመንግስትን የምግብ ደህንነት የመቆጣጠር አቅም ላይ ተጽዕኖ እንዳሳደረ ስጋቶች እየተነሱ ነው።
oromo: Yeroo ammaa kana biyyi Ameerikaa dhibee vaayirasii 'Cyclospora' jedhamu namoota 11,000 ol irratti mul'ateen dararamaa jirti. Ogeeyyiin fayyaa akka jedhanitti, yeroo bulchiinsa Traampitti dhaabbilee fayyaa akka FDA fi CDC irratti hir'inni bajataa taasifame to'annoo nageenya nyaataa irratti dhiibbaa geessisee jiraachuu mala jedhamee shakkamaa jira. Giddu galeessi kun guddina rakkoo fayyaa kanaa to'achuun mootummaan hamma fedhuu akka hin dandeenye yaaddoon jira.

title: OpenAI faces new lawsuits over Tumbler Ridge mass shooting tragedy
english: OpenAI and its CEO, Sam Altman, are facing dozens of new lawsuits regarding a 2026 mass shooting in Tumbler Ridge, Canada. The plaintiffs allege the company acted negligently by failing to report the shooter’s violent plans to authorities after she discussed them with ChatGPT. While Altman previously apologized for this oversight, victims and witnesses are now seeking legal accountability for the tragedy that resulted in eight deaths.
amharic: OpenAI እና ዋና ስራ አስፈፃሚው ሳም አልትማን በካናዳ ታምብለር ሪጅ በተፈጠረው የጅምላ ግድያ ምክንያት በበርካታ አዳዲስ ክሶች ተጠያቂ እየሆኑ ነው። ተከሳሾቹ ኩባንያው ጥቃት አድራሡ የነበራትን የጥቃት እቅድ ከChatGPT ጋር ስትወያይ ለፖሊስ ባለማሳወቁ ቸልተኝነት ፈፅሟል ሲሉ ይከሳሉ። ሳም አልትማን ቀደም ብለው ይቅርታ ቢጠይቁም፣ የተጎጂ ቤተሰቦች እና የአይን እማኞች ስምንት ሰዎችን ለቀጠፈው ይህ አሳዛኝ ክስተት ኩባንያው ህጋዊ ተጠያቂነት እንዲወስድ እየጠየቁ ነው።
oromo: OpenAI fi hoji gaggeessaan isaanii Sam Altman, magaalaa Tumbler Ridge, Kaanaadaatti weerara ajjeechaa raawwatame ilaalchisee himannaa haaraa hedduu mudataniiru. Himatamtoonni, shororkeessituun sun karoora ishee kan ChatGPT wajjin mari’atte utuu beekanii qondaaltootaf gabaasuu dhabuun isaanii dagannoo cimaa akka ta’e himatu. Sam Altman dursee dhiifama gaafatus, miidhamtoonni fi ragaan ijoollee fi barsiisota dabalatee lubbuun sadii fi shantanii darbuu isaa hordofee, kampaniin kun akkaataa seeraatiin gaafatamuu akka qabu dubbatu.

title: Protests in Spain over government's handling of Ceuta migrant crisis
english: Thousands of people across Spain have held mass demonstrations to criticize the government's response to the recent influx of thousands of migrants into the North African territory of Ceuta. Opposition leaders argue that Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez has neglected the region's security, while the government maintains that these protests are politically motivated. Protesters are demanding that the migrants be removed or relocated, as thousands remain in the city amidst ongoing social tension.
amharic: በሰሜን አፍሪካ የምትገኘው ሴኡታ በተባለችው የስፔን ግዛት በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ስደተኞች በመግባታቸው ምክንያት በመላው ስፔን ሰፊ የተቃውሞ ሰልፎች ተካሂደዋል። የተቃዋሚ ፓርቲዎች ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ፔድሮ ሳንቼዝ ለክልሉ ደህንነት ትኩረት እንዳልሰጡ በመግለጽ ይወቀሳሉ፤ መንግስት በበኩሉ ተቃውሞው የፖለቲካ ዓላማ ያለው ነው ሲል ይከራከራል። ተቃዋሚዎቹ ስደተኞቹ በአስቸኳይ ወደ ሀገራቸው እንዲመለሱ ወይም በስፔን ውስጥ ወደ ሌሎች አካባቢዎች እንዲዛወሩ እየጠየቁ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Godina Si’uuta kan kaaba Afrikaa keessatti argamuutti godaantotni kumaatamaan lakkaa’aman galuu isaaniitiin walqabatee, biyya Ispeen keessatti hiriirri mormii bal’aan gaggeeffameera. Paartiileen mormituu, muummeen ministiraa Pedro Sánchez nageenya naannichaa eeguu irratti dadhabuu isaaniin himatu; mootummaan garuu mormiin kun faayidaa siyaasaaf kan qophaa’e dha jedha. Hiriirtonni godaantotni kun gara biyya isaaniitti akka deebi’an ykn gara naannolee biraatti akka gatamaniifi mootummaan gahee isaa akka bahu gaafachaa jiru.

title: Watch: Jury still unable to reach unanimous decision in Lindsay Clancy case
english: In the ongoing trial of Lindsay Clancy, a Massachusetts mother accused of killing her three young children in 2023, the jury has failed to reach a unanimous verdict for the second time in two days. The former nurse is facing murder charges for the strangulation deaths of her children at their home. Despite the deadlock, the judge has instructed the jurors to continue their deliberations to try and reach a final decision.
amharic: እ.ኤ.አ. በ2023 ሶስት ልጆቻቸውን በመግደል የተከሰሱት የማሳቹሴትስ ነዋሪዋ ሊንዚ ክላንሲ የፍርድ ሂደት ላይ ያለው ዳኞች፣ ለሁለተኛ ጊዜ በአንድ ድምፅ መወሰን አልቻሉም። የቀድሞዋ ነርስ በቤታቸው ውስጥ ልጆቻቸውን አንቀው ገድለዋል በሚል የቅጣት ክስ ቀርቦባቸዋል። ዳኛው ምንም እንኳን ስምምነት ላይ መድረስ ባይቻልም፣ ዳኞቹ ውሳኔ ላይ ለመድረስ እንዲሞክሩ እና ውይይታቸውን እንዲቀጥሉ ትእዛዝ ሰጥተዋል።
oromo: Hanga ammaa qorannoo irratti kan argamtu Lindsay Clancy, haati Maasaachuuset irraa taate isheen ijoollee ishii sadii bara 2023 ajjeeste jedhamtee himatamte, murtii tokko irra gahuu dadhabeera. Kanneen seeraa koreen kun guyyaa lama keessatti yeroo lammaffaaf walii galuu dadhabuusaanii ibsaniiru. Inni kanaan dura hojjataa fayyaa ture kun, ijoollee ishii manuma keessatti ukkaamsitee ajjeeste jedhamee himatamaa jira. Haala kanaan walii galuun erga dadhabamee booda, abbaan murtii koreen kun marii isaanii itti fufanii murtoo dhumaa irra akka gahan ajajeera.

title: Republican senator calls on Trump to fire Secretary of Defence Hegseth
english: Republican Senator Thom Tillis has urged President Donald Trump to dismiss Secretary of Defence Pete Hegseth, citing poor leadership and mismanagement of the US military during the ongoing war with Iran. Tillis claims that Hegseth is undermining the armed forces by prioritizing cultural conflicts over professional military readiness. This call for removal follows the resignation of Army Secretary Dan Driscoll, highlighting internal instability within the Pentagon.
amharic: የሪፐብሊካኑ ሴናተር ቶም ቲሊስ፣ ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የመከላከያ ሚኒስትሩን ፒት ሄግሴትን ከኃላፊነታቸው እንዲያነሱ ጠይቀዋል። ሴናተሩ ሚኒስትሩ ከአይራን ጋር በሚካሄደው ጦርነት ወቅት ወታደራዊ አመራሩን በአግባቡ ባለመምራትና የባህል ጦርነቶች ላይ በማተኮር የሀገሪቱን መከላከያ አቅም እያዳከሙ ነው ሲሉ ይከሳሉ። ይህ ጥያቄ የመጣው የጦር ኃይሎች ሚኒስትሩ ዳን ಡሪስኮል ከሥራ መልቀቃቸውን ተከትሎ በአሜሪካ መከላከያ ሚኒስቴር ውስጥ በተፈጠረው አለመረጋጋት ነው።
oromo: Senatorri paartii Rippabilikaanii Thom Tillis, prezidaant Donald Traamp ministeera ittisa biyyaa Pete Hegseth gabaabaa yeroo keessatti aangoo irraa akka kaasan gaafataniiru. Senatorichi, Hegseth waraana Iran waliin ta'uun walqabatee raayyaa ittisa biyyaa gaggeessuu keessatti hanqina guddaa akka qabanii fi dhimma waraanaarratti xiyyeeffachuu mannaa waldhabdee aadaarratti akka xiyyeeffatan himataniiru. Gaaffiin kun kan ka'e erga ministeerri waraanaa Dan Driscoll hojii gadhiisanii booda, ministeericha keessatti jeequmsi akka uumame hordofuudha.

title: Israeli PM says Israel is working to overthrow Iran’s government
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu recently stated that his administration is actively pursuing the removal of the current Iranian government. During a media interview, he emphasized that all Israeli state systems are under instructions to work toward the collapse of the regime. This declaration marks a significant escalation in the public rhetoric between the two nations.
amharic: የእስራኤል ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ የእስራኤል መንግስት የኢራንን የአሁኑን አስተዳደር ከስልጣን ለማውረድ እየሰራ መሆኑን ገለጹ። በሰጡት ጋዜጣዊ መግለጫ፣ የሀገሪቱ ሁሉም የመንግስት ተቋማት የኢራንን መንግስት ለመጣልና ለማዳከም እየሰሩ መሆኑን አስታውቀዋል። ይህ ንግግር በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ያለውን የፖለቲካ ውጥረት የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Mummichi ministeeraa Israa'el Benyamin Netanyaahuun mootummaan isaanii mootummaa Iraan aangoo irraa buusuuf qophaa'aa akka jiran ibsaniiru. Hirmaannaa miidiyaa tokko irratti akka dubbatanitti, sirni mootummaa Israa'el hundi mootummaa Iraan cabsuuf hojjechaa jira. Ibsi kun walitti dhufeenya biyyoota lamaan gidduu jiru caalaatti kan hammeessu ta'uun isaa hubatameera.

title: Children return to school in DR Congo amid growing concerns over Ebola
english: Students in the Democratic Republic of Congo have started a new academic year despite significant anxiety regarding the ongoing Ebola outbreak. While government officials have implemented safety protocols to prevent the virus from spreading in schools, many parents remain unconvinced. The situation continues to create tension as families weigh the importance of education against the risks of infection.
amharic: በዲሞክራቲክ ሪፐብሊክ ኮንጎ አዲስ የትምህርት ዘመን ቢጀመርም፣ በሀገሪቱ እየተስፋፋ ባለው የኢቦላ ወረርሽኝ ምክንያት ወላጆች ከፍተኛ ስጋት ውስጥ ናቸው። የመንግስት ባለስልጣናት በቫይረሱ እንዳይያዙ የመከላከያ እርምጃዎችን መውሰዳቸውን ቢገልጹም፣ ብዙ ቤተሰቦች ግን በጉዳዩ ላይ ጥርጣሬ አላቸው። ይህ ሁኔታ የልጆችን ትምህርት ከበሽታው ስጋት ጋር በማነጻጸር ረገድ ትልቅ ውጥረት ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Jamhuuriya Dimokiraatawaa Koongoo keessatti barattoonni waggaa barnootaa haaraa kan jalqaban ta'us, dhibee Eebolaa babal'achaa jiruun walqabatee sodaatni guddaan jira. Mootummaan dhibee kana ittisuuf tarkaanfiiwwan barbaachisaa ta'an fudhatamuu ibsus, maatiin baay'een garuu amanamummaa tarkaanfichaa irratti shakki qabu. Haalichi maatiin barnoota ijoollee isaanii fi soda dhibee kana gidduutti akka falman taasiseera.

title: Israel still wants to remove Palestinians from Gaza, defence minister says
english: Israeli Defence Minister Israel Katz recently stated that the government still views the forced relocation of Palestinians from Gaza as the only viable long-term solution for the territory. Although a U.S.-backed ceasefire agreement currently prohibits such forced displacement, Katz indicated that Israeli leadership remains committed to emptying the area. This stance persists despite international condemnation and objections from neighboring countries like Egypt regarding the mass removal of the population.
amharic: የእስራኤል መከላከያ ሚኒስትር እስራኤል ካትዝ እንደተናገሩት የእስራኤል መንግስት ፍልስጤማውያንን ከጋዛ ማስወጣት ብቸኛው ዘላቂ መፍትሄ እንደሆነ አሁንም ያምናል። ምንም እንኳን በአሜሪካ ድጋፍ የተደረሰው የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት የግዳጅ መፈናቀልን የሚከለክል ቢሆንም፣ የእስራኤል ባለስልጣናት አካባቢውን ባዶ ለማድረግ ያላቸውን ፍላጎት አላቋረጡም። ይህ አቋም እንደ ግብፅ ካሉ ጎረቤት አገራት ከፍተኛ ተቃውሞ እና አለም አቀፍ ትችቶች ቢኖሩም እስካሁን አልተቀየረም።
oromo: Ministirri ittisaa Israa'el Israa'el Kaatz akka jedhanitti, mootummaan Israa'el namoota Falasxiin Gaazaa keessaa buqqisuun furmaata waaraa qofa akka ta'e amanuu isaa itti fufeera. Waliigaltee waraana dhaabuu kan US deeggaru tokko jiraatuus, hoggantoonni Israa'el naannicha nama irraa duwwoomsuuf karoorfataa jiru. Dhimmi kun biyyoota ollaa akka Maasir irraa mormii cimaa fi mormii idil-addunyaa irratti kan kaase ta'us, Israa'el yaada ishee kanatti cichiteetti.

title: Two Palestinians killed as settlers, Israeli forces raid West Bank village
english: Two 19-year-old Palestinian teenagers were killed by Israeli forces and settlers during a raid on the West Bank village of al-Mughayyir. According to local officials, soldiers opened fire as residents attempted to defend their village against the incursion. This incident follows a consistent pattern of increasing violence against Palestinians in the region, which has led to significant casualties throughout the year.
amharic: በምዕራብ ባንክ አል-ሙጋይር መንደር በተፈጸመ ወረራ በእስራኤል ወታደሮችና ሰፋሪዎች ሁለት የ19 ዓመት ፍልስጤማውያን ወጣቶች ተገድለዋል። የአካባቢው ባለስልጣናት እንደገለጹት፣ ነዋሪዎቹ መንደራቸውን ለመከላከል ሲሞክሩ ወታደሮች በተኩስ እንዲሞቱ አድርገዋል። ይህ ድርጊት በክልሉ በፍልስጤማውያን ላይ እየተባባሰ የመጣውን የጥቃት ሁኔታ የሚያሳይ ሲሆን፣ በዓመቱ ውስጥ በብዙዎች ላይ ጉዳት አስከትሏል።
oromo: Godina Lixaa, baadiyaa Al-Mughayyir jedhamutti haleellaa humnoota Israa’el fi qe’ee buqqaatonni (settlers) raawwataniin dargaggoonni lamman waggaa 19 ta’an ajjeefamaniiru. Gaanjeessoonni naannichaa akka jedhanitti, yeroo jiraattonni baadiyaa isaanii ittisuuf yaalanitti loltoonni dhukaasa banuun lubbuu isaanii dabarsaniiru. Gochi kun naannichatti haleellaa fi dhiibbaa dargaggoota irratti raawwatamu kan agarsiisu yoo ta’u, waggaa kana keessa namoota hedduu irratti miidhaan cimaan ga’eera.

title: Turkey replaces Russian oil and diesel imports from US as wars reverberate
english: Turkey has shifted its oil and diesel sourcing from Russia to the United States and India due to ongoing instability in Russian energy infrastructure caused by the war in Ukraine. Recent customs data shows that the U.S. became Turkey's primary crude oil supplier in June, surpassing Russia. Additionally, Turkey has reached record-high levels of diesel imports from the U.S. and India to meet its domestic energy needs.
amharic: በዩክሬን ጦርነት ሳቢያ በሩሲያ የኃይል ማመንጫ ተቋማት ላይ እየደረሰ ባለው ጥቃት ምክንያት፣ ቱርክ የነዳጅ አቅርቦቷን ከሩሲያ ወደ አሜሪካ እና ህንድ ቀይራለች። የጉምሩክ መረጃዎች እንደሚያሳዩት በሰኔ ወር አሜሪካ ቱርክን በዋናነት ድፍድፍ ነዳጅ የምታቀርብ ሀገር ሆናለች። ከዚህም በተጨማሪ ቱርክ የሀገር ውስጥ ፍላጎቷን ለማሟላት ከአሜሪካ እና ከህንድ የምታስገባው የናፍጣ መጠን ከፍተኛ ደረጃ ላይ ደርሷል።
oromo: Turkiin waraana Yukreeniin walqabatee bu'uuraalee misooma anniisaa Raashiyaa irratti miidhaan waan ga'eef, gabaan ishee gara Ameerikaa fi Indiyaatti jijjiiratteetti. Ragaaleen akka agarsiisaniitti, ji'a Waxabajjii keessa Ameerikaan biyya guddaa beekamtii argattee Turkiif boba'aa dhiheessitu taateetti. Kana malees, Turkiin fedhii biyya keessaa guuttachuuf boba'aa diizaalii Ameerikaa fi Indiyaa irraa galchitu baay'ina isaan rikoordii haaraa galmeessiseera.

title: 'Inappropriate to say': Trump may still be considering CIA-led uprising in Iran
english: President Trump declined to confirm whether the US would support an armed uprising in Iran following recent military strikes on the country. When asked if he would authorize the CIA to arm Iranian protesters, he stated that it was not appropriate to discuss such plans publicly. This comes amid high tensions after US airstrikes resulted in multiple civilian casualties, with conflicting reports regarding the total number of protesters killed in the region.
amharic: ፕሬዚዳንት ትራምፕ በኢራን ላይ የቅርብ ጊዜ ጥቃቶችን ካደረሱ በኋላ፣ አሜሪካ በሀገሪቱ የታጠቀ አመፅን እንደምትደግፍ በግልጽ አልተናገሩም። ሲአይኤ የኢራን ተቃዋሚዎችን እንዲያስታጥቅ ይፈቅዳሉ ወይ ተብለው ሲጠየቁ፣ ስለእቅዳቸው በይፋ መናገር ተገቢ እንዳልሆነ ገልጸዋል። ይህ የሆነው የአሜሪካ የአየር ድብደባ ለበርካታ ንፁሃን ህይወት መጥፋት ምክንያት ከሆነ በኋላ ሲሆን፣ በኢራን የተቃውሞ ሰልፎች የሞቱት ሰዎች ቁጥር በተመለከተም የተለያየ መረጃ እየወጣ ነው።
oromo: Pireezidanti Tiraamp erga weerara waraanaa Iiraanirratti gaggeessanii booda, Ameerikaan finxa xinxalamee fi hidhata qabu akka gargaartu ilaalchisee yaada ifaa hin kennine. CIA'n mormitoota Iiraan akka hidhachiisuuf hayyama ni kennituu jedhamanii gaafatamnaan, waan akkasii ifatti dubbachuun sirrii miti jechuun deebisaniiru. Kun kan ta'e erga weerarri xiyyaaraa Ameerikaa lubbuu namoota nagaa hedduu galaafatee booda yoo ta'u, lakkoofsi namoota mormii Iiraanirratti du'anii ilaalchisees odeeffannoowwan walfaallessan dhaga'amaa jiru.

title: Israeli military announces military exercise in occupied West Bank
english: The Israeli military has scheduled a training exercise for Thursday in the northern part of the occupied West Bank. Residents should expect increased movement of security forces in areas including Jenin and Tulkarem from the morning until midday. Officials have clarified that this is a routine drill and does not indicate an actual security emergency.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይል በሰሜናዊው የዌስት ባንክ አካባቢ ሐሙስ ዕለት ወታደራዊ ልምምድ እንደሚያደርግ አስታውቋል። በጄኒን እና በቱልካረም አካባቢዎች ከጠዋት እስከ እኩለ ቀን ድረስ የፀጥታ ኃይሎች እንቅስቃሴ እንደሚጨምር ተገልጿል። ይህ ልምምድ መደበኛ መሆኑን እና ምንም አይነት የፀጥታ ስጋት እንደሌለው ባለስልጣናት አረጋግጠዋል።
oromo: Waraanni Israa'el guyyaa Kamisaa naannoo Kaaba Baanki Liixaatti shaakala waraanaa akka gaggeessu beeksiseera. Hojiin kun ganama irraa eegalee hanga waaree boodaatti kan turu yoo ta'u, magaalonni akka Jenin fi Tulkarem keessatti sochiin humnoota nageenyaa ni dabala. Mootummaan akka ibsetti, shaakalli kun kan idilee ta'ee fi sodaan nageenyaa tokko illee akka hin jirre ibseera.

title: Half of Americans think post-9/11 wars were worth it, poll shows
english: A recent YouGov poll reveals that nearly half of Americans believe the military interventions and increased surveillance measures implemented after the 9/11 attacks were worthwhile. While Republicans are significantly more likely to support these actions than Democrats, many citizens also acknowledge that Muslims have faced the most mistreatment in the years since. As the 25th anniversary of the attacks approaches, the public remains split on whether these policies have truly made the nation safer.
amharic: የቅርብ ጊዜ የዩጎቭ (YouGov) የሕዝብ አስተያየት እንደሚያሳየው፣ ከሴፕቴምበር 11 ጥቃት በኋላ የተወሰዱት ወታደራዊ እርምጃዎች እና ጥብቅ የክትትል ስራዎች ውጤታማ እንደነበሩ ግማሽ ያህሉ አሜሪካውያን ያምናሉ። ምንም እንኳን ሪፐብሊካኖች ከዲሞክራቶች በበለጠ ለነዚህ እርምጃዎች ድጋፍ ቢሰጡም፣ ብዙዎቹ ዜጎች ሙስሊሞች ከተጠቃው ክስተት በኋላ ከፍተኛ አድልዎ እንደደረሰባቸው ይስማማሉ። የጥቃቱ 25ኛ ዓመት በዓል ሲቃረብ፣ እነዚህ ፖሊሲዎች አሜሪካን ይበልጥ ደህንነቱ የተጠበቀ አድርገዋታል ወይ በሚለው ጉዳይ ላይ በህዝቡ ዘንድ የተለያየ አስተያየት አለ።
oromo: Qorannoon haaraan 'YouGov' gaggeesse akka argisiisutti, namoonni Amerikaa walakkaan isaanii tarkaanfii waraanaa fi hordoffii cimaa weerara Sadaasa 11 booda fudhatame barbaachisaa ture jedhanii amanu. Haata'u malee, deggertoonni paartii Ripaabilikaanii deggarsa guddaa kan qaban yoo ta'u, lammiileen hedduun muslimoonni weeraricha booda miidhaan guddaan irra ga'uu isaa ni amanu. Ayyaanni waggaa 25ffaa weerarichaas dhihaachaa jirutti, tarkaanfiileen kun biyyattii amma nageenya qabeessa taasiseera moo miti jedhurratti yaanni uummataa garaagarummaa qaba.

title: 'Inappropriate to say': Trump may still be considering CIA-led uprising in Iran
english: President Donald Trump has refused to confirm whether he would authorize the CIA to arm Iranians to spark a violent uprising against their government. This comes following recent US military strikes on Iran, including an attack that resulted in civilian casualties at a wedding. While the president claims the Iranian regime is weakening, the conflict continues to escalate with no clear end in sight.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በኢራን መንግስት ላይ አመጽ እንዲነሳ ሲባል የሲአይኤ ወኪሎች ለኢራናውያን የጦር መሳሪያ እንዲያስታጥቁ ይፈቅዱ እንደሆነ ለመናገር ፈቃደኛ አልሆኑም። ይህ የሰላሳውያን ንግግር የተሰማው አሜሪካ በኢራን የባህር ዳርቻ ባደረሰችው እና በሰላማዊ ሰዎች ላይ ጉዳት ባደረሰ ጥቃት ማግስት ነው። ትራምፕ የኢራን መንግስት እየተዳከመ ነው ቢሉም፣ ግጭቱ ከሰባት ወራት በላይ እየቀጠለ ይገኛል።
oromo: Pirezidaanti Doonaald Tiraamp, mootummaa Iraan irratti finxaala uumuuf jecha mootummaan Ameerikaa garee CIA fayyadamuun ummata Iraan meeshaan hidhachiisuu danda'a moo hin danda'u gaaffii jedhuuf deebii kennuu didaniiru. Kunis kan ta'e, Ameerikaan naannoo qarqara galaana Iraanitti haleellaa raawwattee namoota nagaa ajjeestee guyyaa tokko booda. Tiraamp mootummaan Iraan laafaa akka jiru dubbatanis, waraanni kun ji'oota torbaaf itti fufee akka jiru fi xumura hin qabaanne hubatameera.

title: Iranian attack on Saudi tanker killed two Filipino sailors, Saudi Arabia says
english: Saudi Arabia has blamed Iran for a maritime attack on a Saudi supertanker that resulted in the deaths of two Filipino crew members. The incident occurred in the Strait of Hormuz, where another tanker was also reportedly struck amidst rising regional tensions. While Iran has not addressed the specific accusation, they previously claimed ships were damaged by mines in the area during a period of escalating military exchanges with the United States.
amharic: ሳውዲ አረቢያ በሆርሙዝ ባህረ ሰላጤ በሳውዲ የነዳጅ ማመላለሻ መርከብ ላይ የተፈጸመው ጥቃት በኢራን የተፈጸመ እንደሆነ በመግለጽ ሁለት የፊሊፒንስ መርከበኞች መሞታቸውን አስታውቃለች። በተመሳሳይ ጊዜ ሌላ የደቡብ ኮሪያ መርከብም ጥቃት እንደደረሰበት የተነገረ ሲሆን፣ ክስተቱ በክልሉ እየተባባሰ በመጣው የኢራን እና የአሜሪካ ግጭት ውስጥ የተፈጠረ ነው። ኢራን በጉዳዩ ላይ እስካሁን ምላሽ አልሰጠችም፣ ነገር ግን ቀደም ብላ መርከቦቹ በማዕድን (ማይኖች) እንደተጎዱ መግለጿ ይታወሳል።
oromo: Saudii Arabiyaan haleellaa bidiruu ishee irratti raawwatamee fi lubbuu lammiilee Filipinpins lamaa galaafateef Iran akka himattu ibsiteetti. Balaan kun kan mudate yeroo walitti bu'iinsi biyyoota gidduu jiru daran hammaachaa jirutti, bidiruun biyya Kibba Kooriyaa tokkos haleellaa akka mudate gabaafameera. Iran hanga ammaatti himannaa kana irratti kan hin dubbanne yoo ta'u, kanaan dura garuu bidiruuleen kunniin lafarra biyyee keessa hawwii (mine) keessa darbanii akka miidhaman ibsitee turte.

title: Dreams shattered: Gaza amputees struggle under blockade and rubble
english: Shurouq Khaira, a former athlete in Gaza, lost her leg during an Israeli attack in late 2023, ending her dreams of Olympic competition. She and her family are now living in a tent amidst rubble, where she struggles daily with limited mobility and the lack of prosthetic support. Despite her permanent disability and the ongoing hardships caused by the war and blockade, she maintains a sense of endurance.
amharic: የቀድሞዋ የጋዛ አትሌት ሹሩቅ ካይራ እ.ኤ.አ. በ2023 መጨረሻ በእስራኤል ጥቃት እግሯን በማጣቷ የኦሊምፒክ ተሳትፎ ህልሟ ተቋርጧል። በአሁኑ ወቅት እሷ እና ቤተሰቧ በፈራረሱ ቤቶች መካከል በድንኳን ውስጥ የሚኖሩ ሲሆን፣ በተገደበ የመንቀሳቀስ አቅም እና በሰው ሰራሽ እግር እጦት ከፍተኛ ችግር ውስጥ ይገኛሉ። በጦርነቱ እና በተጣለው እገዳ ምክንያት የዘላቂ አካል ጉዳተኛ ብትሆንም፣ በጽናት ለመኖር እየታገለች ትገኛለች።
oromo: Atileetii duraanii Gaazaatti argamtu Shuruuq Khaayiraa, dhuma bara 2023 haleellaa Israa'el mudateen miilla ishee dhabuun abjuun ishee dorgommii Olompikii irratti hirmaachuuf qabdu daangaa irra ga'eera. Amma maatii ishee waliin mana diigame keessatti dunkaana keessa jiraachaa jirti; akkasumas sochiin ishee daangeeffamuu fi gargaarsa miilla biraatiin (prosthetic) dhabuun rakkoo guddaa keessa galteetti. Waraanaa fi uggura jiruun miidhaan ishee dhaabbataa ta'us, jabinaan jireenya ishee itti fuftee jirti.

title: Saudi Arabia condemns deadly Iranian attack on tanker in Strait of Hormuz
english: Saudi Arabia has formally denounced an Iranian attack on a national oil tanker while it passed through the Strait of Hormuz, an incident that tragically resulted in the deaths of two Filipino crew members. Regional neighbors, including Qatar and Kuwait, joined in the condemnation, labeling the assault a violation of international maritime laws and the freedom of navigation. This event is part of a larger ongoing conflict between Iran and a US-Israeli alliance, raising significant concerns regarding the security of global energy supplies.
amharic: ሳዑዲ ዓረቢያ በሆርሙዝ ባህር ሰላጤ በኩል ሲያልፍ በነበረ የሀገሪቱ የነዳጅ መርከብ ላይ ኢራን የፈጸመችውን ጥቃት በጽኑ አውግዛለች፤ ጥቃቱም የሁለት የፊሊፒንስ ዜጋ የሆኑ የመርከብ ሰራተኞችን ህይወት ቀጥፏል። እንደ ኳታር እና ኩዌት ያሉ የክልሉ አገራትም ጥቃቱን ዓለም አቀፍ የባህር ላይ ህጎችን እና የመንቀሳቀስ ነጻነትን የሚጥስ ድርጊት ነው በማለት ኮንነውታል። ይህ ድርጊት በኢራን እና በአሜሪካ-እስራኤል ጥምረት መካከል እየተካሄደ ባለው ውዝግብ ውስጥ የተከሰተ ሲሆን፣ ዓለም አቀፍ የነዳጅ አቅርቦት ደህንነት ላይ ስጋት ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Saudii Arabiyaan haleellaa Iiraan doonii boba’aa biyyattii irratti lafa dhiphoo Hormuzitti raawwatte kan balaaleffatte yoo ta’u, haleellaa kanaan hojjettoota biyya Filippiins lama ta’an du’aniiru. Biyyoonni ollaa akka Kaataar fi Kuweetis, gochi kun seera idil-addunyaa fi mirga imala galaanaa kan cabsu ta’uu ibsuun mormaniiru. Haleellaan kun waldhabdee Iiraanii fi gamtaa Ameerikaa-Israa’eel gidduutti adeemaa jiru keessatti kan dhalate ta’ee, dhiyeessiin boba’aa addunyaa nageenya isaa irratti yaaddoo guddaa uumee jira.

title: US says it will use regional body to isolate Nicaragua
english: The United States is working through the Organization of American States to isolate Nicaragua following new constitutional changes that effectively eliminate political opposition. Secretary of State Marco Rubio condemned these reforms, which also lengthen presidential terms, as an assault on democracy. This pressure aims to stop other nations from maintaining normal relations with the Ortega government.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መንግስት በኒካራጓ የተካሄደውን የህገ-መንግስት ለውጥ ተከትሎ ሀገሪቱን ከአህጉራዊ ተቋማት ለማግለል እየሰራ መሆኑን አስታውቋል። አዲሱ ህገ-መንግስት የተቃዋሚ ፓርቲዎችን ከምርጫ የሚያግድ እና የፕሬዚዳንቱን የስልጣን ዘመን የሚያራዝም በመሆኑ የአሜሪካ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ማርኮ ሩቢዮ ለዴሞክራሲ ስጋት እንደሆነ ገልጸዋል። አሜሪካ የአሜሪካ ሀገራት ድርጅትን በመጠቀም ሌሎች ሀገራት ከኒካራጓ ጋር ያላቸውን ግንኙነት እንዲቀንሱ ግፊት ታደርጋለች።
oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa jijjiirama heera mootummaa Niikaraaguwaa keessatti godhame hordofee, biyyattii qaamolee naannichaa irraa addaan baasuuf hojjechaa jira. Heerri haaraan kun paartileen mormituu akka filannoo keessatti hin hirmaanne kan dhowwuu fi yeroo aangoo pirezidaantummaa kan dheeressu waan ta'eef, ministeerri dhimmi alaa Ameerikaa Maarkoo Ruubiyoo tarkaanfichaan sirna dimookiraasii irratti balaa kan uume jedhaniiru. Ameerikaan dhaabbata biyyoota Ameerikaa fayyadamuun, biyyoonni biroon hariiroo idilee Niikaraaguwaa wajjin qaban akka dhaaban dhiibbaa gochuuf karoorfateera.

title: Malta businessman acquitted of plotting journalist Caruana Galizia murder
english: A Maltese jury has acquitted businessman Yorgen Fenech of charges related to the 2017 assassination of investigative journalist Daphne Caruana Galizia. Although prosecutors claimed he orchestrated the murder to silence her corruption reports, Fenech was cleared of all charges following a jury trial. The journalist's family expressed deep disappointment with the verdict, noting that the systemic failures that allowed her killing to happen remain unresolved in Malta.
amharic: የማልታ ፍርድ ቤት የንግድ ሰው የሆኑትን ዮርገን ፌኔክን በ2017 የተገደለችውን የምርመራ ጋዜጠኛ ዳፍኒ ካሩአና ጋሊዚያን ግድያ በማቀነባበር ተከስሰው የነበረ ቢሆንም ከክሱ ነፃ ብሏቸዋል። አቃቤ ህግ ግለሰቡ የሙስና ዘገባዎችን ለማስቆም ግድያውን አቀነባብረዋል ብሎ ቢከስም፣ የዳኞች ቡድን በስምንት ለአንድ ድምፅ ነፃ እንዲባሉ ወስኗል። የሟች ቤተሰቦች ብይን በሰጡበት ወቅት ከፍተኛ ሀዘን የተሰማቸው ሲሆን፣ አገሪቱ ለጋዜጠኛዋ የገባችውን የፍትህ ቃል እንዳላከበረች ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Mana murtii Maaltaa, daldalaan Yorgen Fenech jedhaman, bara 2017 gaazixeesituu qorattu Daafnii Kaaru-aanaa Gaaliziyaa ajjeesuun himatamanis, himata hundarraa bilisa ta'aniiru. Abbaan alangaa, daldalaan kun gabaasa malaammaltummaa isaa saaxiluuf jettu dhaabsisuuf ajjeechaa kana qindeesse jedhee himatullee, yaa'iin murteessituu (jury) sagalee saddeetiin tokko irratti hundaa'uun bilisa isaan taasiseera. Maatiin gaazixeesittii ajjeefamtee kun murtee kanaan gadda guddaa kan ibsan yoo ta'u, biyyattiin gaazixeesittii kana eeguuf dadhabuushee fi haqni akka hin argamne dubbataniiru.

title: EU pursuing more Russia sanctions after failed airport attack: Kallas
english: European Union foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas has announced that the EU is preparing additional sanctions against Russia following a failed drone attack on a German airport. The bloc plans to target approximately 1,600 more individuals and entities, as well as tighten visa restrictions, in response to what officials have labeled state-sponsored terrorism. While Russia denies any involvement in the incident, the EU remains committed to increasing financial and diplomatic pressure to weaken Moscow's military capabilities.
amharic: የአውሮፓ ህብረት የውጭ ጉዳይ ኃላፊ ካጃ ካላስ በጀርመን አውሮፕላን ማረፊያ ላይ የተሞከረውን የድሮን ጥቃት ተከትሎ በሩሲያ ላይ ተጨማሪ ማዕቀቦችን እየጣሉ መሆናቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ህብረቱ ይህንን ድርጊት የመንግስት ስፖንሰር የተደረገ የሽብርተኝነት ተግባር ሲል የገለጸው ሲሆን፣ ከዚህ ጋር በተያያዘም 1,600 የሚሆኑ ግለሰቦችንና ተቋማትን በዝርዝሩ ውስጥ ለማካተት አቅዷል። ሩሲያ በድርጊቱ ተሳትፎ እንዳላት ብትክድም፣ የአውሮፓ ህብረት የሞስኮን የጦር አቅም ለመቀነስ ዲፕሎማሲያዊና ኢኮኖሚያዊ ግፊቱን አጠናክሮ ለመቀጠል ወስኗል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni siyaasa ala kan Gamtaa Awurooppaa Kaja Kallas, buufata xiyyaaraa Jarmanii irratti yaaliin haleellaa doonii (drone) erga fashalaa'ee booda, Gamtaan Awurooppaa qophii adabbii cimaa irratti akka jiru beeksisaniiru. Gamtaan kun haleellaa kana 'shororkeessummaa mootummaan deeggaramu' jechuun balaaleffateera; kanaafis namoota fi dhaabbilee 1,600 ol ta'an irratti adabbii biroo buusuuf karoorfata. Rusiyaan hirmaannaa qabaachuu ishee haaltus, Gamtaan Awurooppaa dandeettii waraanaa Rusiyaa laaffisuuf dhiibbaa diippiloomaasii fi diinagdee itti fufuuf murteesseera.

title: Woman charged with juror intimidation in Lindsay Clancy trial
english: Dawn Light, a 56-year-old woman, has been charged with aggravated juror intimidation after allegedly photographing jury members during the high-profile murder trial of Lindsay Clancy. Authorities discovered the images on her phone after she was found in a restricted area near the courthouse, though her attorney claims the incident was a misunderstanding intended to capture a photo of the defendant. The judge has ordered Light to stay away from the courthouse and the trial participants while the legal case proceeds.
amharic: ዶውን ላይት የተባለች የ56 ዓመት ሴት በሊንሳይ ክላንሲ የፍርድ ሂደት ወቅት የዳኝነት አባላትን ፎቶግራፍ በማንሳቷ የዳኞችን ደህንነት አደጋ ላይ ጥለሻል በሚል ክስ ተመሰረተባት። ተከሳሡ በችሎቱ አካባቢ በተከለከለ ቦታ ተገኝታ ፎቶግራፍ እያነሳች እንደነበረ የተደረሰባት ሲሆን፣ ጠበቃዋ ግን ድርጊቱ የተሳሳተ ግንዛቤ እንጂ ክላንሲን ለመቅረጽ የተደረገ ሙከራ እንደነበር ተከራክረዋል። ዳኛው ተከሳሡ ከፍርድ ቤቱ አካባቢ እና ከጉዳዩ ጋር ግንኙነት ካላቸው ሰዎች እንዲርቁ ትዕዛዝ ሰጥተዋል።
oromo: Dubartii umriin ishee 56 Dawn Light jedhamtu, seeraan qorannaa irra kan jiru dhimma Lindsay Clancy irratti miseensota juriitiif sodaachisa gootee jetti himatamte. Himatamtuun tun bakka seeraan dhorkamee jirtuutti miseensota juriitii suuraa kaasuun ishee sakatta'iinsa bilbila isheetiin mirkanaa'eera, garuu abukaaton ishee suuraa kaasuun ishee dogoggoraan kan ta'eefaa fi kaayyoon ishee Lindsay Clancy qofa suuraa kaasuu akka ture dubbateera. Abbaan seeraa himatamtuun tun mana murtiichaa fi namoota dhimma kana wajjin walqabatan irraa akka fagaattu ajajeera.

title: Brazilian activist demands Tunisia release Sumud Flotilla organisers
english: Brazilian activist Thiago Avila is calling for the release of four Tunisian organizers who were part of the Global Sumud Flotilla mission to provide aid to Gaza. These individuals, who were previously detained by Israel, have been held by Tunisian authorities for over five months on allegations of financial misconduct. Their supporters argue that these charges are politically motivated and intended to silence their efforts to support Palestinians.
amharic: የብራዚላዊው አክቲቪስት ቲያጎ አቪላ የጋዛን የእርዳታ ማገጃ ለመስበር በተዘጋጀው የሱሙድ ፍሎቲላ ተልዕኮ ውስጥ የተሳተፉ አራት የቱኒዚያ አዘጋጆች እንዲለቀቁ ጠይቀዋል። ቀደም ሲል በእስራኤል ታስረው የነበሩት እነዚህ ግለሰቦች፣ አሁን በቱኒዚያ መንግስት የገንዘብ ማጭበርበር ክስ ቀርቦባቸው ከአምስት ወር በላይ በእስር ላይ ይገኛሉ። ደጋፊዎቻቸው እንደገለጹት፣ እነዚህ ክሶች የፍልስጤምን ህዝብ ለመርዳት የሚያደርጉትን ጥረት ለማዳከም የተፈጠሩ የፖለቲካ መሰረት ያላቸው ውንጀላዎች ናቸው።
oromo: Duudha-galeessii Braazil Tiyaago Avilaa namoota afur kanneen gargaarsa gara Gaazaatti geessuuf duula 'Sumud Flotilla' irratti hirmaatan akka gadhiifaman gaafachaa jira. Namoonni kunneen kanaan dura Israa'elitti hidhamanii turan, amma immoo mootummaan Tuniisiyaa himata yakka maallaqaa irratti banuudhaan ji'oota shantii oliif hidhaa keessa turaniiru. Deggertoonni isaanii himatni kun qabsoo isaan fal'sxiinota gargaaruuf godhan dhaabsisuuf kan qophaa'e fi siyaasaa kan qabu ta'uu dubbatu.

title: US oil giant Chevron to expand Venezuela operations
english: Chevron is planning to invest over $7 billion to significantly increase its oil production in Venezuela to 600,000 barrels per day within the next five years. The company has secured additional land in the Orinoco Belt to support this growth, which coincides with broader U.S. efforts to boost energy output from the region. By utilizing existing infrastructure and obtaining better legal and commercial terms, the firm expects to maintain low production costs.
amharic: ቼቭሮን በሚቀጥሉት አምስት ዓመታት ውስጥ በቬንዙዌላ ያለውን የነዳጅ ምርት በቀን ወደ 600,000 በርሜል ለማሳደግ ከ7 ቢሊዮን ዶላር በላይ ኢንቨስት ለማድረግ አቅዷል። ኩባንያው ይህንን ዕቅድ ለማሳካት በኦሪኖኮ ቤልት አካባቢ ተጨማሪ መሬት የተረከበ ሲሆን፣ ይህም ከአሜሪካ የኢነርጂ ፍላጎት ጋር የሚጣጣም ነው። በነባር መሠረተ ልማቶች እና በተሻሻሉ ህጋዊ ስምምነቶች አማካኝነት ኩባንያው የምርት ወጪውን ዝቅተኛ ሆኖ እንዲቀጥል ለማድረግ አቅዷል።
oromo: Chevron waggoota shan dhufan keessatti oomisha isaa biyya Veenzuweelaa keessatti gara barmeela 600,000 guyyaatti guddisuuf doolaara biliyoona 7 ol baasuf karoorfateera. Dhaabbatichi guddina kanaaf akka gargaaru naannoo Oorinoo-koo keessatti lafa dabalataa argateera; kunis carraaqqii Ameerikaan anniisaa naannichaa dabaluuf gootuun kan wal simatuudha. Bu'uuraalee misoomaa kanaan dura jiran fayyadamuufi waliigaltee seeraa fooyya'aa argachuun, dhaabbatichi baasii oomisha isaa gadi bu'aa ta'e akka eeggatu abdata.

title: Uber lays off 3,300 employees in largest cuts since the pandemic
english: Uber has announced the layoff of 3,300 employees, representing 10% of its total workforce, to streamline management and improve operational efficiency. CEO Dara Khosrowshahi stated that these changes are necessary to simplify the company structure as it pivots toward an autonomous future and prioritizes investments in drivers and AI technology. Furthermore, the company is shifting away from remote work, with plans to require nearly all staff to return to the office.
amharic: ኡበር 3,300 ሰራተኞቹን ወይም አጠቃላይ የሰው ኃይሉን 10 በመቶ እንደሚቀንስ አስታውቋል። ኩባንያው ይህንን ውሳኔ የወሰደው የአስተዳደር መዋቅሩን ለማሳለጥ፣ ውጤታማነትን ለመጨመር እና ወደ አውቶማቲክ ቴክኖሎጂዎች ለማዘንበል መሆኑን ዋና ስራ አስፈፃሚው ዳራ ኮስሮሻሂ ገልጸዋል። ከዚህም በተጨማሪ ኩባንያው በአብዛኛው ከቤት የመሥራት ልምድን በማስቀረት፣ አብዛኛዎቹ ሰራተኞች ወደ ቢሮ ተመልሰው እንዲሰሩ ለማድረግ አቅዷል።
oromo: Uber hojjettoota isaa 3,300 kan ta’an ykn 10% humna namaa isaa hojiirraa gaggeessuu isaa beeksiseera. Murtoon kun kan fudhatame caaseffama bulchiinsa isaanii salphisuuf, bu’a qabeessummaa dabaluuf fi gara teknooloojii ofiin of sochoosuun geggeeffamuuf ce’uuf akka ta’e hoji gaggeessaan olaanaa Daaraa Koosrooshaahii ibsaniiru. Dabalataanis, dhaabbatichi hojii manarraa hojjechuu dhiisuun hojjettoota isaa baay’ee gara biirootti deebi’anii akka hojjetan dirqisiisuuf karoorfateera.

title: Deadly bus crash in Egypt’s Sinai kills 22, injures 28
english: A tragic bus accident in Egypt’s South Sinai region resulted in the deaths of 22 people and left 28 others injured. The vehicle flipped over while traveling on the road between Dahab and Nuweiba. Reports indicate that at least ten of the victims were citizens of Jordan.
amharic: በግብፅ ደቡባዊ ሲናይ በደረሰ የትራፊክ አደጋ 22 ሰዎች ሲሞቱ 28 ሰዎች ደግሞ ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። አደጋው የተከሰተው አውቶቡሱ ከዳሃብ ወደ ኑዌይባ በሚወስደው መንገድ ላይ ሲገለበጥ ነው። ከተጎጂዎቹ መካከል አስር የዮርዳኖስ ዜጎች እንደሚገኙበት ተገልጿል።
oromo: Misiroo konkolaataa kutaa Siinaa kibbaa gibxii keessatti mudateen lubbuun namoota 22 yoo darbu, namoonni 28 immoo miidhamaniiru. Balaan kun kan mudate konkolaatichi karaa Dahabii fi Nuweebaa gidduu jiru irratti yeroo garagale dha. Gabaasota irraa akka hubatametti, namoota du'an keessaa kudhan lammiilee Yordaanos ta'uun mirkanaa'eera.

title: Zambia’s Hichilema begins second term amid disputed vote and arrests
english: President Hakainde Hichilema has started his second term in Zambia following an election victory that has been challenged by the opposition. While the government claims success in stabilizing the economy and managing debt, international observers have criticized the fairness and transparency of the voting process. Additionally, the administration faces criticism due to the recent arrests of key opposition leaders on treason charges.
amharic: የዛምቢያው ፕሬዚዳንት ሃካኢንዴ ሂቺሌማ በምርጫ ውጤቱ ላይ ተቃውሞ እና የፖለቲካ ውጥረት በተፈጠረበት ወቅት ሁለተኛ የስልጣን ዘመናቸውን ጀምረዋል። መንግስታቸው የሀገሪቱን ኢኮኖሚ በማረጋጋት ረገድ ውጤታማ እንደሆነ ቢገልጽም፣ ዓለም አቀፍ ታዛቢዎች የምርጫ ሂደቱ ፍትሃዊነት እና ግልጽነት ላይ ጥያቄ አንስተዋል። ከዚህ በተጨማሪም ዋና ዋና የተቃዋሚ ፓርቲ መሪዎች በክህደት ወንጀል መታሰራቸው በፕሬዚዳንቱ አስተዳደር ላይ ትልቅ ትችት አስከትሏል።
oromo: Pirezidaanti Haakayindee Hiichileemaa filannoo mormii guddaa kaase booda, xumura yeroo isaanii kan ta'e waggoota shan lammataa hojiitti seenaniiru. Mootummaan isaanii dinagdee biyyattii tasgabbeessuu fi liqii hordofuun milkaa'ina akka argate ibsus, daawwattoonni idil-addunyaa garuu adeemsi filannichaa qulqullinaa fi iftoomina akka hin qabaanne himaniiru. Kana malees, hoogganoonni mormituu ijoo ta'an yakka ganuutiin hidhamuun isaanii mootummaa pirezidaantichaa irratti qeeqa cimaa fidee jira.

title: Joint Egyptian-Chinese statement: Palestinian cause is central in Middle East
english: During a state visit to Cairo, Chinese President Xi Jinping and Egyptian President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi emphasized that the Palestinian issue is vital for regional stability. Both leaders pledged their support for an independent Palestinian state based on 1967 borders, with East Jerusalem serving as its capital. This diplomatic meeting also marked the 70th anniversary of the partnership between China and Egypt.
amharic: የቻይናው ፕሬዝዳንት ዢ ጂንፒንግ እና የግብፁ ፕሬዝዳንት አብዱልፈታህ አልሲሲ በካይሮ ባደረጉት ውይይት፣ የፍልስጤም ጉዳይ ለመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ሰላም እጅግ ወሳኝ መሆኑን አስታውቀዋል። ሁለቱ መሪዎች እ.ኤ.አ. በ1967 ድንበር ላይ የተመሰረተ እና ምስራቅ እየሩሳሌምን ዋና ከተማ ያደረገ ሉዓላዊ የፍልስጤም መንግስት እንዲቋቋም ድጋፋቸውን ገልጸዋል። ይህ ጉብኝት የሁለቱን ሀገራት የዲፕሎማሲ ግንኙነት 70ኛ ዓመት በዓል ጋር የተገናኘ ነበር።
oromo: Pireezidaantii Chaayinaa Sii Jingpiing fi Pireezidaantii Gibxii Abdulfataah Alsisiin Kaayirootti mari'ataniin, gaaffiin Falasxiin nageenya Baha Giddu-galeessaaf murteessaa ta'uu mirkaneessaniiru.
